mula:
ವರ್ಗಪ್ರಥಮಂಗಳ್ ತ
ದ್ವರ್ಗತೃತೀಯಂಗಳಪ್ಪುವುೞಿಯೆ ಪವರ್ಗಂ
ವರ್ಗದ್ವಿತೀಯವರ್ಣಂ
ವರ್ಗಪ್ರಥಮಂ ಚತುರ್ಥಮಱಿಗೆ ತೃತೀಯಂ
vrtti: ಪವರ್ಗಮಂ ಕಳೆದುೞಿದ ವರ್ಗಂಗಳ ಮೊದಲ ಕ ಚ ಟ ತಂಗಳ್ ತಮ್ಮ ಮೂಱನೆಯ ಗ ಜ ಡ ದಂಗಳಪ್ಪುವು; ವರ್ಗದೆರಡನೆಯ ಖ ಛ ಠ ಥ ಫಂಗಳ್ ತಮ್ಮ ಮೊದಲ ಕ ಚ ಟ ತ ಪಂಗಳಪ್ಪುವು; ವರ್ಗದ ನಾಲ್ಕನೆಯ ಘ ಝ ಢ ಧ ಭಂಗಳ್ ತಮ್ಮ ಮೂಱನೆಯ ಗ ಜ ಡ ದ ಬಂಗಳಪ್ಪುವು.
english: The first letters of the classes, leaving out the p-class, become the third letters of their class; the second letter of a class becomes the first of the class; know that the fourth becomes the third.
explanation_en: Three stop changes in tadbhavas: (1) voiceless unaspirated k c ṭ t become voiced g j ḍ d (p is excluded; p has its own rule 258) — typically between vowels, e.g. -ika suffix → -ige (ದೀಪಿಕಾ→ದೀವಿಗೆ); (2) voiceless aspirates kh ch ṭh th ph lose aspiration → k c ṭ t p; (3) voiced aspirates gh jh ḍh dh bh lose aspiration → g j ḍ d b. The rule is stated generally but, as everywhere in this chapter, applies to attested words; examples also show co-occurring changes (ph→h in ಫಲಕ→ಹಲಗೆ by 258, v→b, final -ā→-e).
heading_en: Voicing of k c ṭ t; deaspiration

conditions: word: Sanskrit word taken as tadbhava
target: a stop of the k-, c-, ṭ-, t-classes (p-class excluded for rule 1)
rule.operation: replace k→g, c→j, ṭ→ḍ, t→d (prathama→tṛtīya; mostly intervocalic/medial, occasionally initial: ಕೋಟಾ→ಗೋಡೆ, ಕುಟಿ→ಗುಡಿ)
also: replace kh→k, ch→c, ṭh→ṭ, th→t, ph→p (dvitīya→prathama)
replace gh→g, jh→j, ḍh→ḍ, dh→d, bh→b (caturtha→tṛtīya)

examples.note: c→j; also initial k→g, final a→u (278)

ಗತ್ವಂ ಛತ್ವಂ ದ್ವಿರುಕ್ತಿಯಿಂ ಕೂಡಿರೆ ಮೇಣ್

ದ್ವಿತ್ವಂ ಛತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಸತ್ವಮುಂಟರೆಯೆಡೆಯೊಳ್
vrtti: ಖಕಾರಕ್ಕೆತ್ತಾನುಂ ಗಕಾರಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಛಕಾರಂ ದಡ್ಡಕ್ಕರಮಾಗಿರ್ದೊಡಂ ಮೇಣ್ ಯಕಾರಂ ಬೆರಸಿರ್ದೊಡಂ ದ್ವಿತ್ವಮಪ್ಪ ಚಕಾರಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಛಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಸಕಾರಮುಂ ಕೆಲವೆಡೆಯೊಳಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: For kh, variably, g; ch, when joined by doubling or when accompanied by y, becomes doubled c; for ch there is also s in some places.
explanation_en: (1) kh may become g (instead of k by 255): ಮುಖ→ಮೊಗ. (2) ch that is geminate (cch) or followed by y (chy) becomes geminate cc: ಇಚ್ಛಾ→ಇಚ್ಚೆ, ಮತ್ಸ್ಯ (written ಮಛ್ಯ)→ಮಚ್ಚ. (3) Initial ch sometimes becomes s: ಛುರಿಕಾ→ಸುರಿಗೆ.

rule.operation: replace kh→g (bahula)
also: replace cch (doubled ch) → cc
replace chy → cc (y lost)
replace ch→s in some words (word-initial in the examples)

mula:
ಅರಮೆ ಠಕಾರಂ ಡೞದಿಂ
ಪರಿಣಮಿಕುಂ ಸತ್ವಮಿಶ್ರಮಪ್ಪ ಥಕಾರಂ
ಬರೆಯುಂ ತಕಾರಮಕ್ಕುಂ
ಸ್ವರಾನ್ವಿತಂ ಥತ್ವಮೊರ್ಮೆ ದ ಟ ಹಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ
vrtti: ಎತ್ತಾನುಂ ಕೆಲವು ಶಬ್ದಂಗಳ ಠಕಾರಂ ಡ ೞಕಾರಮಾಗಿ ಪರಿಣಮಿಕುಂ; ಸಕಾರದೊಡವೆರಸಿದ ಥಕಾರಂ ಸ್ವರಾನ್ವಿತಮಪ್ಪ ತಕಾರಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಥಕಾರಮೊರ್ಮೆ ದಕಾರಮುಂ ಟಕಾರಮುಂ ಹಕಾರಮುಂ ಅಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: In some places ṭh changes into ḍ and ḻ; th mixed with s, when it comes, becomes t with its vowel; th sometimes becomes d, ṭ and h.
explanation_en: (1) ṭh becomes ḍ (ಕುಠಾರ→ಕೊಡಲಿ) or ḻ (ಮಠಿಕಾ→ಮೞ್ಗೆ) in some words. (2) In the cluster sth/sth- the s is lost and th becomes plain t, keeping the vowel (ಸ್ಥಾನ→ತಾಣ, ಅವಸ್ಥಾ→ಅವತೆ). (3) th occasionally becomes d (ವೀಥಿ→ಬೀದಿ), ṭ (ಗ್ರಂಥಿ→ಗಂಟು) or h (ಗಾಥಾ→ಗಾಹೆ).

conditions: word: Sanskrit word taken as tadbhava (only some words: ಅರಮೆ 'in some places')
rule.operation: replace ṭh→ḍ | ḻ
also: replace sth → t (s deleted, th deaspirated; vowel retained), word-initially or medially
replace th → d | ṭ | h (ಒರ್ಮೆ, occasionally)

mula:
ಅವತರಿಸಿರ್ಕುಂ ಪತ್ವ
ಕ್ಕೆ ವತ್ವಹತ್ವವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಕೆಲಕೆಲವೆಡೆಯೊಳ್
ಸವನಿಸುಗುಂ ಬತ್ವಕ್ಕೊ
ರ್ಮೆ ವತ್ವಮುಂ ವತ್ವದೆಡೆಗೆ ಬತ್ವಂ ಬಹುಳಂ
vrtti: ಪಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ವಕಾರಮುಂ ಹಕಾರಮುಂ ಕೆಲಕೆಲವೆಡೆಯೊಳಕ್ಕುಂ; ಬಕಾರಕ್ಕೊರ್ಮೆ ವಕಾರಮುಂ, ವಕಾರಕ್ಕೊರ್ಮೆ ಬಕಾರಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: In a few places the arrangement of v and h arises for p; v sometimes comes about for b; and in place of v, b, variably.
explanation_en: Labial changes: (1) p becomes v, chiefly between vowels (ದೀಪಿಕಾ→ದೀವಿಗೆ, ವಾಪಿ→ಬಾವಿ); (2) p becomes h, chiefly word-initially (ಪಂಜರ→ಹಂಜರ, ಪಾಶ→ಹಾಸ) — the well-known Kannada p>h change; (3) b sometimes becomes v (ಕಬಲ→ಕವಳ); (4) v very often becomes b, especially word-initially (ವೀಣಾ→ಬೀಣೆ). All are lexically restricted.

conditions: word: Sanskrit word taken as tadbhava
rule.operation: replace p→v (medial/intervocalic in examples) | p→h (initial, or medial after vowel: ಗೋಪುರ→ಗೋಹುರ)
also: replace b→v (ಒರ್ಮೆ, sometimes)
replace v→b (bahula; word-initial in all examples)

examples.note: p→h; also d→v (267), k→g, final a→e
v→b; footnote: fat; female elephant; barren cow

mula:
ಘನಮಿಲ್ಲ ಯತ್ವದೊಳ್ ಗ
ತ್ವನತ್ವವಿಧಿ ಪಿರಿದು ಜತ್ವವಿಧಿ ಮತ್ತಂ ದ
ತ್ವನಿಯುಕ್ತಯತ್ವಮುಂ ಜ
ತ್ವನಿಯತಮಂ ಕೆಲವು ಶಬ್ದದೊಳಾಳ್ದಿರ್ಕುಂ
vrtti: ಯಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಗಕಾರ ನಕಾರಾದೇಶಂ ಕಿಱಿದೆಡೆಯೊಳುಂಟು; ಆ ಯಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಜಕಾರಾದೇಶಂ ಪಿರಿದು; ದಕಾರದೊಳ್ಕೂಡಿದ ಯಕಾರಕ್ಕಂ ದ್ವಿತ್ವದ ಜಕಾರಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: For y the rule of g and n is not frequent; the rule of j is frequent; and y joined to d also takes the rule of j in some words.
explanation_en: (1) y rarely becomes g (ದ್ವಿತೀಯಾ→ಬಿದಿಗೆ) or n (ಯುಗ→ನೊಗ). (2) y very frequently becomes j, especially word-initially (ಯೋಗಿ→ಜೋಗಿ). (3) The cluster dy becomes geminate jj (ಉದ್ಯೋಗ→ಉಜ್ಜುಗ, ವಿದ್ಯಾ→ಬಿಜ್ಜೆ).

conditions: word: Sanskrit word taken as tadbhava
rule.operation: replace y→j (frequent; word-initial y, and y after r in ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ→ದುಜ್ಜೋದನ)
also: replace y→g (rare; in -īyā/-yā endings: ದ್ವಿತೀಯಾ→ಬಿದಿಗೆ)
replace y→n (rare)
replace dy→jj

ತವಿಂಧ್ಯವಂಧ್ಯಾಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಸಂಧ್ಯಾಧ್ಯಾನ
ಪ್ರವಿದಿತದಧಕಾರಂಗ
ಳ್ಗವಶಿಷ್ಟಯಕಾರಮಂತೆ ಜತ್ವಮನಾಳ್ಗುಂ

explanation_en: In dy/dhy clusters of these listed words the upper d/dh is deleted and the remaining y becomes j (by 259): dyūta→jūdu, dhyāna→jāna, sandhyā→sañje.
heading_en: dy, dhy → j in listed words

mula:
ನೆಗೞ್ಗುಂ ದ್ವಿತ್ವಾಗ್ರದ ರೇ
ಫೆಗೆ ಲೋಪಂ ವರ್ಣಮಿಶ್ರರೇಫಕ್ಕಂ ತಾಂ
ನೆಗೞ್ಗುಂ ಲೋಪಂ ಬಹುಳದೆ
ನೆಗೞ್ಗುಂ ವೃತರೇಫಮಡಿಯೊಳಾ ವರ್ಣದ ವೋಲ್
vrtti: ದಡ್ಡಕ್ಕರದ ಮೇಲಣ ರೇಫೆಗೆ ಲೋಪಂ; ಬಳಸಿದ ರೇಫೆಗಂ ಬಹುಳದಿಂ ಲೋಪಂ; ಆ ಸುತ್ತಿದ ರೇಫೆ ತನ್ನೊಳಿರ್ದಕ್ಕರದಂತೆ ದ್ವಿರ್ಭಾವಮಂ ಕೆಲವೆಡೆಯೊಳ್ ತಳೆಗುಂ. ಅರ್ಕ ದರ್ದುಗಳೆರಡಱ ಮೇಲಣ ರೇಫೆಗೆ ತದ್ಭವಮಾದೊಡಂ ಬಹುಳದಿಂ ಲೋಪಮಿಲ್ಲ — ಅರ್ಕ-ಎರ್ಕೆ; ದರ್ದು-ತರ್ದು ಈ ತೆಱದಿನಿರ್ಪುವು. ಅವರ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಂ.
english: Elision occurs for the repha standing on top of a doubled [consonant]; for a repha mixed with a letter [i.e. subscript r], elision also occurs variably; the enclosed repha below becomes like that letter.
explanation_en: (1) Pre-consonantal r (repha written above a consonant, which Old Kannada orthography doubles: ರ್ಕ್ಕ) is deleted, leaving a geminate: ಧರ್ಮ→ದಮ್ಮ, ಮರ್ಕಟ→ಮಕ್ಕಡ. Exceptions (bahula): ಅರ್ಕ→ಎರ್ಕೆ and ದರ್ದು→ತರ್ದು keep their r. (2) Post-consonantal r (C+r) is variably deleted: ಚಂದ್ರ→ಚಂದ, ಪ್ರಭು→ಹಬು. (3) In some words the deleted post-consonantal r is replaced by gemination of the preceding consonant (it 'becomes like that letter'): ನಿದ್ರಾ→ನಿದ್ದೆ, ನೇತ್ರ→ನೆತ್ತ, ತೀವ್ರ→ತಿಬ್ಬ (vowel before the geminate is shortened).

conditions: word: Sanskrit word taken as tadbhava
target: r + C (repha, pre-consonantal) or C + r (subscript r)
rule.operation: rC → CC: delete pre-consonantal r and geminate the following consonant (obligatory; exceptions ಅರ್ಕ, ದರ್ದು)
also: Cr → C: delete post-consonantal r (bahula), no gemination (ಚಂದ್ರ→ಚಂದ, ಶ್ರವಣ→ಸವಣ)
Cr → CC: delete post-consonantal r and geminate C (some words; preceding long vowel shortened: ನೇತ್ರ→ನೆತ್ತ, ಸೂತ್ರಿಕಾ→ಸುತ್ತಿಗೆ)

mula:
ದ್ವಿತ್ವಂ ಬೆರಸಿದ ಕತ್ವಂ
ಚತ್ವಂ ಖತ್ವಂ ಯಥಾಪ್ರಯೋಗದಿನಕ್ಕುಂ
ಕ್ಷತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಬಹುಳದಿಂದಂ
ಸತ್ವಂ ಕತ್ವಂ ದ್ವಿರುಕ್ತಿಯಿಲ್ಲರೆಯೆಡೆಯೊಳ್
vrtti: ಕ್ಷಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ದ್ವಿತ್ವಂ ಬೆರಸಿದ ಕಕಾರಮುಂ ಚಕಾರಮುಂ ಖಕಾರಮುಂ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಾನುಸಾರಮಾಗಿ ಬಹುಳದಿನಕ್ಕುಂ; ಆ ಕ್ಷಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಸಕಾರಮೊರ್ಮೆ ಘಟಿಯಿಸುಗುಂ; ದ್ವಿತ್ವಮಿಲ್ಲದ ಕಕಾರಮುಂ ಕ್ಷಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಕಿಱಿದೆಡೆಯೊಳಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: For kṣ, variably, k, c, kh joined with doubling occur according to usage; s, and k without doubling, in some places.
explanation_en: Sanskrit kṣ becomes (1) geminate kk (ಪಕ್ಷ→ಪಕ್ಕ), (2) geminate cc (ಅಕ್ಷ→ಅಚ್ಚು), or (3) geminate khkh (ಪ್ರಕ್ಷಾಲ→ಪಖ್ಖಳ), according to usage; kṣṇ also gives kk (ತೀಕ್ಷ್ಣ→ತಿಕ್ಕ); (4) sometimes s (ಕ್ಷೇಮ→ಸೇಮ), and (5) sometimes single k (ಕ್ಷೀರ→ಕೀರ, ದೀಕ್ಷಾ→ದೀಕೆ). A long vowel before the new geminate is shortened (ಸಾಕ್ಷಿ→ಸಕ್ಕಿ).
heading_en: kṣ → kk / cc / khkh / s / k

conditions: word: Sanskrit word taken as tadbhava
target: kṣ (also kṣṇ)
rule.operation: replace kṣ → kk | cc | khkh (choice by usage; kk most common)
also: replace kṣṇ → kk
replace kṣ → s (sometimes; word-initial in examples)
replace kṣ → k (single, in some words)
shorten a long vowel before the resulting geminate

mula:
ಪಡೆಗುಂ ಮತ್ವಂ ವತ್ವಮ
ನಡಸಿದ ಚತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಸತ್ವದತ್ವಂ ಶ ಷ ತಂ
ಪಡೆಗುಂ ಚಕಾರಮಂ ತಾಂ
ಪಡೆಗುಂ ಬಹುಳದೆ ಹಕಾರದೆಡೆಯಂ ಯ ಗ ಣಂ
vrtti: ಪರದೊಳಗಣ ಮಕಾರಂ ವಕಾರಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಚಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಸಕಾರಮುಂ ದಕಾರಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಶ ಷ ತಂಗಳ್ಗೆ ಚಕಾರಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಹಕಾರಂ ಬಹುಳದಿಂ ಯಕಾರಮುಂ ಗಕಾರಮುಂ ಣಕಾರಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: m acquires v; for c occurring [in words], s and d; ś, ṣ, t acquire c; y, g, ṇ variably take the place of h.
explanation_en: (1) m becomes v, mostly non-initially (ಗ್ರಾಮ→ಗಾವ, ಕುಂಕುಮ→ಕುಂಕುವ). (2) c becomes s (ಚೀರ→ಸೀರೆ) or d (ಉಚ್ಚ→ಉದ್ದ). (3) ś, ṣ and t become c, especially in clusters, giving cc (ನಿಶ್ಚಲ→ನಿಚ್ಚಲ, ಷಷ್ಠಿ→ಚಟ್ಟಿ, ನಿತ್ಯ→ನಿಚ್ಚ); the prayoga also gives s→c variably (ಹಂಸ→ಅಂಚೆ, ಕಾಂಸ್ಯ→ಕಂಚು). (4) h variably becomes y (ಕುಹಕ→ಕೊಯಕ), g (ಸಿಂಹ→ಸಿಂಗ) or ṇ (ಸನ್ನಾಹ→ಸನ್ನಣ).
heading_en: m→v; c→s/d; ś ṣ s t→c; h→y/g/ṇ

conditions: word: Sanskrit word taken as tadbhava
rule.operation: replace m→v (non-initial m in all examples)
also: replace c→s (initial c, and medial c in ಕ್ರಕಚ→ಕರಗಸ, ಮರಿಚ→ಮೆಳಸು)
replace c→d (cc→dd)
replace ś→c, ṣ→c, t→c (śc/ty/tk/ts clusters → cc; initial ś/ṣ → c)
replace s→c (bahula; ps/ms/s → c/cc)
replace h→y | g | ṇ (bahula)

examples.note: h→g; Skt paṭaha; Kittel ಹಡಹು, o.r. ಪಡಹು

mula:
ತಳೆಗುಂ ಮೇಲಣ ಕ ಸ ಪಂ
ತಳದ ತಕಾರಸ್ವರೂಪಮಂ ಮೇಗೆ ತಗು
ಳ್ದೆಳಸಿದ ಹಕಾರಮುಂ ತಳ
ದೊಳಿರ್ದ ಮ ನಕಾರರೂಪಮಂ ಧರಿಯಿಸುಗುಂ
vrtti: ಮೇಲಿರ್ದ ಕ ಸ ಪಾಕ್ಷರಂಗಳ್ ಕೆಳಗಣ ತಕಾರರೂಪಮಾಗಿ ಪರಿಣಮಿಸುಗುಂ; ಮೇಲಣ ಹಕಾರಮುಂ ಕೆಳಗಣ ಮಕಾರ ನಕಾರಮಾಗಿ ಪರಿಣಮಿಸುಗುಂ.
english: Upper k, s, p take the form of the t below; h, attached and standing above, takes the form of the m or n standing below.
explanation_en: Regressive assimilation in clusters: in kt, st, pt the first consonant becomes t, giving tt (ಶುಕ್ತಿ→ಸುತ್ತಿ, ಪುಸ್ತಕ→ಹೊತ್ತಗೆ, ಗುಪ್ತ→ಗುತ್ತ); in hm and hn the h becomes m / n, giving mm / nn (ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ→ಬೊಮ್ಮ, ಚಿಹ್ನ→ಚಿನ್ನ). Alternatively the cluster may be split by 254 (ಯುಕ್ತಿ→ಜುಗುತಿ, ಜುಕುತಿ).
heading_en: kt, st, pt → tt; hm → mm; hn → nn

conditions: target: cluster C1C2 with C1 ∈ {k, s, p} and C2 = t; or C1 = h and C2 ∈ {m, n}
rule.operation: replace C1 → C2 (total regressive assimilation): kt→tt, st→tt, pt→tt
also: replace hm→mm, hn→nn

examples.note: kt→tt; variants 2-3 by vowel epenthesis (254) instead; variant 1 of 3
kt→tt; variants 2-3 by vowel epenthesis (254) instead; variant 2 of 3
kt→tt; variants 2-3 by vowel epenthesis (254) instead; variant 3 of 3
st→tt; also p→h, u→o, k→g, final a→e

mula:
ತಳದ ಮ ಕಾಕ್ಷರರೂಪಂ
ಗೞಿಯಿಪುದಗ್ರದ ಷಕಾರಮಗ್ರತಕಾರಂ
ತಳದ ಪ ಫ ನಮೆ ದಲಕ್ಕುಂ
ತಳದ ನ ಮಾಕ್ಷರಮೆಯಕ್ಕುಮಗ್ರದ ನ ಣಮುಂ
vrtti: ಮೇಲಣ ಷತ್ವಂ ತಳದ ಮತ್ವ ಕತ್ವಂಗಳಕ್ಕುಂ; ಮೇಲಣ ತತ್ವಂ ಕೆಳಗಣ ಪ ಫ ನಂಗಳಕ್ಕುಂ; ಮೇಲಣ ಣಕಾರ ನಕಾರಂಗಳ್ ಕೆಳಗಣ ನತ್ವ ಮತ್ವಂಗಳಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: Upper ṣ acquires the form of the lower m or k; upper t indeed becomes the lower p, ph, n; upper ṇ and n become just the lower n and m.
explanation_en: More regressive assimilation: ṣm→mm, ṣk→kk (ಪುಷ್ಕರಿಣೀ→ಹೊಕ್ಕರಣೆ); tp→pp, tph→pp/pph, tn→nn (ರತ್ನ→ರನ್ನ); ṇ (in rṇ) → nn (ಕರ್ಣ→ಕನ್ನ, with r-loss 261); nm→mm (ಉನ್ಮತ್ತ→ಉಮ್ಮತ್ತ).
heading_en: ṣm, ṣk, tp, tph, tn, rṇ, nm assimilate

conditions: target: cluster C1C2 with C1 = ṣ and C2 ∈ {m, k}; C1 = t and C2 ∈ {p, ph, n}; C1 ∈ {ṇ, n} with lower n / m
rule.operation: replace C1 → C2 (geminate): ṣm→mm, ṣk→kk, tp→pp, tph→pph/pp, tn→nn
also: ṇ → n (rṇ → nn after repha loss)
nm → mm

examples.note: tph→pp; variant 2 Kittel o.r.; variant 1 of 2
tph→pp; variant 2 Kittel o.r.; variant 2 of 2
ṇ→n (rṇ→nn); also final syllable loss, ṭ→ḍ

mula:
ಜ ಲ ತದ ಕೆಳಗಣ ವತ್ವಂ
ನ ಲ ತ ವ ಪಾಕ್ಷರದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಕೂಡಿದ ಯತ್ವಂ
ಸಲೆ ಗತ್ವದ ಕೆಳಮೆಯ್ಯೊಳ್
ನೆಲಸಿದ ನತ್ವಂ ತದಾಕೃತಿಯನಾಳ್ದಿರ್ಕುಂ
vrtti: ಪದಂಗಳೊಳ್ ನೆಲಸಿದ ಜಕಾರ ಲಕಾರ ತಕಾರಂಗಳ ಕೆಳಗಿರ್ದ ವಕಾರಮವಱಂತಕ್ಕುಂ; ನಕಾರ ಲಕಾರ ತಕಾರ ಪಕಾರ ವಕಾರಂಗಳ ಕೆಳಗಿರ್ದ ಯಕಾರಮವಱಂತಕ್ಕುಂ; ಗತ್ವದ ಕೆಳಗಣ ನತ್ವಂ ಗತ್ವಮೆಯಕ್ಕುಂ. ಮೃದ್ವೀಕಾ-ಮುದ್ದಿಗೆಯಾದಂತೆ ಕೆಳಗಣಕ್ಕರಮೆ ಮೇಲಣದಪ್ಪುದರ್ಕೆ ಕೆಲವಂ ಪ್ರಯೋಗವಶದಿನಱಿವುದು.
english: The v below j, l, t; the y joined below the letters n, l, t, v, p; and the n settled in the lower part of g — these take the shape of that [upper letter].
explanation_en: Progressive assimilation: the lower member of a cluster becomes identical to the upper one, giving a geminate: jv→jj, lv→ll, tv→tt; ny→nn, ly→ll, ty→tt, vy→bb (v→b), py→pp; gn→gg. Further cases where the lower letter becomes the upper (e.g. dv→dd in ಮೃದ್ವೀಕಾ→ಮುದ್ದಿಗೆ) are to be learned from usage.
heading_en: Cv, Cy, gn → geminate of upper C

conditions: target: cluster C1C2 with C2 = v and C1 ∈ {j, l, t}; C2 = y and C1 ∈ {n, l, t, v, p}; C2 = n and C1 = g
rule.operation: replace C2 → C1 (progressive assimilation, geminate C1C1): jv→jj, lv→ll, tv→tt, ny→nn, ly→ll, ty→tt, vy→bb, py→pp, gn→gg
also: other C1+v/y clusters (e.g. dv→dd) by usage
ḷ substituted for l in some outputs (ಉಜ್ಜ್ವಲ→ಉಜ್ಜಳ)

examples.note: dv→dd (by usage); also ṛ→u (268), ī shortened, k→g

mula:
ವರಜಯತಡವರ್ಣಮನಾ
ಚರಿಪುದು ತಾಂ ಬೇಱೆ ಬೇಱೆ ಪದಚಯದೊಳ್ ಸಂ
ಚರಿಪ ದಕಾರಕ್ಕಾದಂ
ದೊರೆಕೊಳ್ಳುಂ ಕೆಲವು ಶಬ್ದದಾದಿಗೆ ದೀರ್ಘಂ
vrtti: ಪದಂಗಳೊಳ್ ನೆಲಸಿದ ದತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ವತ್ವಮುಂ ರೇಫೆಯುಂ ಜತ್ವಮುಂ ಯತ್ವಮುಂ ತತ್ವಮುಂ ಡತ್ವಮುಮಾದೇಶಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಕೆಲವು ಶಬ್ದಂಗಳಾದಿಗೆ ದೀರ್ಘಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: For d occurring in the multitude of words, [scholars] apply the letters v, r, j, y, t, ḍ, severally; and length is obtained at the beginning of some words.
explanation_en: d is replaced, in individual words, by v (ಪಾದುಕ→ಹಾವುಗೆ), r (ಕದಂಬ→ಕರಂಬ), j (ಗದಾ→ಗಜೆ), y (ಪದ→ಪಯ), t (ದರ್ದು→ತರ್ದು) or ḍ (ವಿಚ್ಛಂದ→ಬಿಚ್ಚಂಡ). Separately, the first vowel of some words is lengthened, often compensating for loss of a medial syllable or of a nasal/h (ಗಹನ→ಗಾನ, ನವಮಿ→ನಾಮಿ, ದಂಷ್ಟ್ರಾ→ದಾಡೆ, ದ್ವಿ-→ದೂ-).

conditions: word: Sanskrit word taken as tadbhava (specific words)
rule.operation: replace d → v | r | j | y | t | ḍ (word-specific)
also: lengthen the first vowel of some words (a→ā; dvi→dū)

examples.note: initial vowel lengthened; medial h lost

`ಕದಂಬ - ಕರಂಬಳ` read `ಕರಂಬ` (Kittel ಕರಂಬಂ; footnote glosses ಕರಂಬ)

mula:
ಪದದಾದಿಯ ಋತ್ವಕ್ಕಿ
ತ್ವದೆತ್ವದತ್ವದ ವಿಧಾನಮುತ್ವಂ ಬಹುಳಂ
ಪುದಿದಿರ್ಕುಮಮೃತಶಬ್ದಾಂ
ತದಲ್ಲಿಯುಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಶಬ್ದದಂತಿರೆ ರೇಫಂ
vrtti: ಪದದ ಮೊದಲ ಋತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಇತ್ವಮುಂ ಎತ್ವಮುಂ ಅತ್ವಮುಂ ಬಹುಳದಿನುತ್ವಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಶಬ್ದದಂತಮೃತಶಬ್ದದ ಕಡೆಗಂ ರೇಫಂ.
english: For word-initial ṛ, the prescriptions of i, e and a are found, and u variably; at the end of the word amṛta, too, as in the word brahma, a repha [occurs].
explanation_en: Vocalic ṛ (as an independent vowel or after the first consonant) becomes i (commonest: ಮೃಗ→ಮಿಗ, ಋಷಿ→ರಿಸಿ with ṛ→ri), e (ಹೃದಯ→ಹೆದೆಯ), a (ವೃಷಭ→ಬಸವ), or variably u (ಮೃದ್ವೀಕಾ→ಮುದ್ದಿಗೆ). Medially it variably becomes a (ಪ್ರಾಕೃತ→ಪಾಗದ, ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ→ಸಕ್ಕದ). In amṛta the ṛ yields a repha before the following consonant (ಅಮೃತ→ಅಮರ್ದು), just as brahma gives ಬರ್ಮ (metathesis of r).
heading_en: ṛ → (r)i / e / a / u; ṛ→ar in amṛta

conditions: target: ṛ in the first syllable (independent ಋ or Cṛ)
rule.operation: replace ṛ → i (independent ಋ → ri) | e | a | u (u bahula)
also: medial ṛ → a (bahula)
amṛta: ṛ → ar (repha before the following consonant), like brahma → barma

examples.note: medial ṛ→a (bahula); also anusvāra loss, sk→kk

uncertain: ṛ printed as `ಯ`/`ಖು` throughout (OCR); restored as ಋ
`ಕೃತಕಿ-ಗದಕಿ` as printed (Kittel line truncated `ಕೃತಕ…`)

mula:
ಆದಿಯೊಳಿರ್ದತ್ವಕ್ಕು
ತ್ವಾದೇಶಮುಮಿತ್ವವೃತ್ತಿಯುಂ ಹತ್ವಮುಮಾ
ಪಾದಿತಮಕ್ಕುಂ ಜ್ಞತ್ವ
ಕ್ಕಾದಿಯನುೞಿದು ನ್ನಮಕ್ಕುಮದು ಬಹುಳತೆಯಿಂ
vrtti: ಪದದಾದಿಯ ಅಕಾರಕ್ಕುಕಾರಮುಮಿಕಾರಮುಂ ಹಕಾರಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಆದಿಯಂ ಕಳೆದುೞಿದ ಜ್ಞತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ದ್ವಿತ್ವದ ನಕಾರಂ ಬಹುಳದಿನಕ್ಕುಂ. ಬಹುಳಮೆಂಬುದಱಿಂದೆ ಆಜ್ಞೆಗೆ ಆಣೆ ಎಂದುಂಟು.
english: For a standing at the beginning, substitution of u, the occurrence of i, and h are prescribed; for jñ, leaving aside the initial position, nn occurs, variably.
explanation_en: (1) A word-initial a (also a in the first syllable after a consonant) may become u (ಅಂಗುಷ್ಠ→ಉಂಗುಟ, ತ್ವರಿತ→ತುರಿಹ), i (ಅಂಗಾರ→ಇಂಗಳ), or take a prothetic h (ಅಗ್ನಿ→ಹಗ್ಗಿ). (2) Non-initial jñ becomes geminate nn (ಯಜ್ಞ→ಜನ್ನ, ವಿಜ್ಞಾಪನ→ಬಿನ್ನಪ); because the rule is bahula, ಆಜ್ಞಾ gives ಆಣೆ instead (cf. 278).

conditions: target: a in the first syllable of the word
target: jñ not word-initial
rule.operation: replace initial a → u | i, or insert h before word-initial a
also: replace non-initial jñ → nn (bahula; alternatively jñ → ṇ, 278)

uncertain: pāda 4 `ಕ್ಕಾದಿಯನುಟದು ನ್ನನಕ್ಕುಮದು` read `ಕ್ಕಾದಿಯನುೞಿದು ನ್ನಮಕ್ಕುಮದು` (Kittel anvaya ನ್ನಂ ಅಕ್ಕುಂ)
`ಬಹುಳಮೆಂಬುದಖುಂದೆ ಆಜ್ಞೆಗೆ ಆಣ` read `…ಆಣೆ` (Kittel `ಆಣೆಯೆಂದುಂಟು`; 278 ಆಜ್ಞೆ-ಆಣೆ)

mula:
ಪದದಾದಿಯುವರ್ಣಕ್ಕೌ
ತ್ವದತ್ವದೆಡೆಗೊತ್ವಮುಂ ಪೊದಲ್ದೋತ್ವಮುಮ
ಪ್ಪುದು ವೈಕಲ್ಪಿಕದಿಂ ಶ
ಬ್ದದಾದಿದೀರ್ಘಕ್ಕೆ ಪಿರಿದುಮಕ್ಕುಂ ಹ್ರಸ್ವಂ
vrtti: ವಿಕಲ್ಪದಿಂ ಪದದಾದಿಯ ಉ ಊ ಎಂಬಿವರ್ಕಂ ಔಕಾರಕ್ಕಂ ಅಕಾರಕ್ಕಂ ಹ್ರಸ್ವೋತ್ವಮುಂ ದೀರ್ಘೋತ್ವಮುಂ ಅಕ್ಕುಂ; ಪದಂಗಳ ಮೊದಲ ದೀರ್ಘಕ್ಕೆ ಪಿರಿದುಂ ಹ್ರಸ್ವಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: In place of the word-initial u-vowels, of au and of a, short o and the well-established long ō occur optionally; for the initial long vowel of a word, a short one occurs frequently.
explanation_en: In the first syllable: u, ū, au and a optionally become short o or long ō (u→o: ಕುಂಡ→ಕೊಂಡ; u→ō: ಕುಕ್ಕುಟ→ಕೋೞಿ; ū→ō: ಮೂಢ→ಮೋಡ; au→o: ಕ್ರೌಂಚ→ಕೊಂಚೆ; au→ō: ಕೌಪೀನ→ಕೋವಣ; a→o: ಸ್ವರ್ಣ→ಸೊನ್ನೆ; a(ya)→ō: ಮಯೂರ→ಮೋರ). In addition, a long vowel in the first syllable is frequently shortened, especially before a geminate created by cluster simplification (ಆರ್ಯ→ಅಜ್ಜ, ಸಾಕ್ಷಿ→ಸಕ್ಕಿ, ಪೂರ್ವ→ಹುಬ್ಬೆ).

conditions: target: vowel of the first syllable of the word
rule.operation: replace u → o | ō; ū → ō; au → o | ō; a → o | ō (optional, vaikalpika)
also: shorten a long vowel of the first syllable (ā→a, ī→i, ū→u, ē→e) — piridum 'frequently'

examples.note: u→ō; also medial loss (275), final a→i
initial long vowel shortened; variant 1 of 2
initial long vowel shortened; variant 2 of 2

uncertain: pāda 2 `ಪೊದಲಕ್ಟೋತ್ಸಮುಮ` read `ಪೊದಲ್ದೋತ್ವಮುಮ` (Kittel ṭīke ಪೊದಲ್ದೊತ್ವಮುಂ)
`ಕುಕ್ಕುಟ-ಕೋಟಾ` read `ಕೋೞಿ` (Kittel `ಕೋಲ್‌`, Old Kannada ಕೋೞಿ 'fowl')
the vṛtti's `ಅಕಾರಕ್ಕಂ` (a) is printed; Kittel also has it
`ರಾಕಸ-ರಕ್ಷಸ` (OCR order) read `ರಾಕ್ಷಸ-ರಕ್ಕಸ`; `ಆರ್ಯ-ಅಜ್ವ` read `ಅಜ್ಜ`; `ಕಾರ್ಯ-ಕಜ` read `ಕಜ್ಜ`; `ತಾತ-ತಂದ್ಕೆ` read `ತಂದೆ`

mula:
ಅಕ್ಕುಮೆವರ್ಣಂ ಭಾವಿಸೆ
ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ ಪದಾದಿಯಿತ್ವದತ್ವದ ಸಂಸ್ಥಾ
ನಕ್ಕಂ ಮತ್ತೈತ್ವಕ್ಕಂ
ಮಿಕ್ಕಾದಿಹಕಾರಮಸ್ವರದೆ ಲೋಪಿಸುಗುಂ
vrtti: ಎ ಏ ಎಂಬಕ್ಕರಂಗಳ್ ಪದಾದಿಯ ಇಕಾರಕ್ಕಮಕಾರಕ್ಕಮೈಕಾರಕ್ಕಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಪದಾದಿಯ ಹಕಾರಂ ಸ್ವರರಹಿತಮಾಗಿ ಲೋಪಮಕ್ಕುಂ. ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ ಎಂಬ ಪರಿಮಿತವಚನದಿಂದಿತ್ವಕ್ಕಮತ್ವಕ್ಕಮೈತ್ವಕ್ಕಂ ಎವರ್ಣಂ ಕೆಲವೆಡೆಯೊಳಿಲ್ಲ.
english: On consideration, the e-vowels occur as appropriate in the place of word-initial i and a, and further for ai; moreover the initial h is elided, without [its] vowel.
explanation_en: In the first syllable, i, a (including ā and ya-) and ai become e or ē (i→e: ಶಿಲಾ→ಸೆಲೆ; i→ē: ನಿಯಮ→ನೇಮ; a→e: ಜಟಾ→ಜೆಡೆ, vya→be/ve; a→ē: ವ್ಯವಹಾರ→ಬೇಹಾರ; ai→e: ವೈದ್ಯ→ಬೆಜ್ಜ; ai→ē: ವೈಶಾಖ→ಬೇಸಗೆ). The word 'as appropriate' (takkante) limits it: many words keep i/a/ai (ನಿಮಿಷ→ನಿಮಿಸ, ಅಂಕುಶ→ಅಂಕುಸ, ಭೈರವ→ಬೈರವ). Also a word-initial h is dropped — only the consonant, the following vowel remains (ಹಿಂಗು→ಇಂಗು).

conditions: target: vowel of the first syllable; restricted to certain words (takkante)
rule.operation: replace i → e | ē; a/ā (incl. after y in vya-) → e | ē; ai → e | ē
also: delete word-initial h (vowel retained): hV → V

counterexamples.why: ನಿಮಿಷ, ನಿಶಾ, ವಿಷ keep i (ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ restricts the e-rule)

uncertain: vṛtti `ಕೆಲವಣಕೊಳಿಲ್ಲ` read `ಕೆಲವೆಡೆಯೊಳಿಲ್ಲ`
`ತೆ ಲಕ - ತೆಲ್ಲಿಗ` read `ತೈಲಿಕ-ತೆಲ್ಲಿಗ` (Kittel)
`ವೈರ - ಬೇದ` read `ಬೇರ` (Kittel `ಬೇರಂ`); uncertain
`ಭೃಕ್ಷ - ಬೈಕ` read `ಭೈಕ್ಷ`; `ಶೈವ ಹ ಸೈವ` read `ಶೈವ-ಸೈವ`
`ಬಿಲ್ವಪತ್ರ - ಬೆಲ್ಲವತ್ತ್ರ` read `ಬೆಲ್ಲವತ್ತ` (cf. 266)

mula:
ಅಕ್ಕುಂ ಸ್ಪರ್ಶ ಸ್ಫಟಿಕ
ಸ್ಫಿಕ್ಕಾ ಸ್ಫೋಟಕದೊಳಂ ಸ್ತುತಿ ಸ್ತಿಮಿತ ಸ್ತೋ
ಮಕ್ಕಿರ್ದ ಪದಾದಿ ಸಕಾ
ರಕ್ಕಂ ಲೋಪಂ ಶ್ಮಶಾನದಾ ಶತ್ವಕ್ಕಂ
vrtti: ಈ ಪೇೞಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ ಶಬ್ದಂಗಳ ಸಕಾರಕ್ಕಂ ಶ್ಮಶಾನಶಬ್ದದ ಶಕಾರಕ್ಕಂ ಲೋಪಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: Elision occurs for the word-initial s present in sparśa, sphaṭika, sphikkā, sphoṭaka, and in stuti, stimita, stoma; and for that ś of śmaśāna.
explanation_en: In the listed words the initial s of an s+stop cluster is dropped (sp→p, sph→ph→h/p, st→t); in śmaśāna the initial ś is dropped (and m-ś metathesis gives ಮಸಣ). Other regular changes co-occur (sph→h by 258: ಸ್ಫೋಟಕ→ಹೋಳಿಗೆ).
heading_en: Initial s- (and ś of śmaśāna) dropped

conditions: words: ಸ್ಪರ್ಶ, ಸ್ಫಟಿಕ, ಸ್ಫಿಕ್ಕಾ, ಸ್ಫೋಟಕ, ಸ್ತುತಿ, ಸ್ತಿಮಿತ, ಸ್ತೋಮ, ಶ್ಮಶಾನ (listed)
target: word-initial s (ś in śmaśāna) before a consonant
rule.operation: delete initial s / ś

examples.note: initial s/ś deleted; also u-epenthesis, ś→s
initial s/ś deleted; printed ಸಿಕ್ಕಾ; variant 1 of 2
initial s/ś deleted; printed ಸಿಕ್ಕಾ; variant 2 of 2

uncertain: pāda 2 `ಸಿಕ್ಕಾ` read `ಸ್ಫಿಕ್ಕಾ` (Kittel `ಸ್ಫಿಕ್ಕಾ`, Kedilaya `ಸ್ಟಿಕ್ಕಾ`; metre needs a conjunct so that pāda 1 ends heavy; the rule concerns s+C clusters)
pāda 4 `ಶಶಾನದಾ` read `ಶ್ಮಶಾನದಾ`
`ಸ್ತಿಮಿತ - ತಿಮಿತತ` read `ತಿಮಿತ`

mula:
ಪದಮಧ್ಯದ ದೀರ್ಘಕ್ಕ
ಪ್ಪುದು ಪೀನಂ ಹ್ರಸ್ವಮೋತ್ವಮಾದಂದುತ್ವಂ
ಪುದಿದುತ್ವಕ್ಕಿತ್ವಮುಮ
ತ್ವದ ಮೆಯ್ಯುಮದತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿಗಿತ್ವಾದೇಶಂ
vrtti: ಪದಮಧ್ಯದ ದೀರ್ಘಕ್ಕೆ ಪಿರಿದುಂ ಹ್ರಸ್ವಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಪದಮಧ್ಯದೋತ್ವಕ್ಕುತ್ವಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಪದಮಧ್ಯದುತ್ವಕ್ಕಿತ್ವಮುಮತ್ವಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಪದಮಧ್ಯದತ್ವಕ್ಕಿತ್ವಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: For a word-medial long vowel, a short one occurs abundantly; where there is ō, u; for u, i and the form of a; and in place of a, substitution of i.
explanation_en: In non-initial syllables: (1) long vowels are commonly shortened (ತಾಂಬೂಲ→ತಂಬುಲ, ಶಲಾಕಾ→ಸಲಗೆ); (2) medial ō becomes u (ಅಶೋಕ→ಅಸುಗೆ); (3) medial u becomes i (ಆಯುಷ್ಯ→ಆಯಿಸ) or a (ಮಾನುಷ→ಮಾನಸ); (4) medial a becomes i (ಕನ್ಯಕಾ→ಕನ್ನಿಕೆ).
heading_en: Medial vowels: long→short, ō→u, u→i/a, a→i

conditions: target: vowel of a non-initial syllable
rule.operation: shorten long vowel (ā→a, ī→i, ū→u, ō→o) — pīnaṃ 'abundantly'
also: replace ō → u
replace u → i | a
replace a → i

examples.note: medial long vowel shortened; also initial ā shortened
medial long vowel shortened; also r→l, final a→i; variant 1 of 2
medial long vowel shortened; also r→l, final a→i; variant 2 of 2
medial long vowel shortened; alternative input reading; variant 1 of 2
medial long vowel shortened; alternative input reading; variant 2 of 2

uncertain: pāda 2 `ಪೀನಂ` (venkat, = abundantly) vs `ಹೀನಂ` (Kedilaya) / `ಖೀನಂ` (Kittel OCR)
pāda 4 `ಮೆಯ್ಕುಮ` read `ಮೆಯ್ಯುಮ` (Kittel)
`ಕುರುಂಟ-ಗೋರಟೆ, ಗೋರಣ್ಣೆ` second read `ಗೋರಂಟೆ` (Kittel `ಗೋರಣ್ಟೆ`)
`ಬರ್ಬೂರ-ಬರ್ಬೂಲ ... ಬೊಬ್ಬುಲಿ, ಬಬ್ಬುಲಿ`: printed as input variants ಬರ್ಬೂರ/ಬರ್ಬೂಲ with outputs ಬೊಬ್ಬುಲಿ/ಬಬ್ಬುಲಿ (Kittel)

mula:
ಪದಮಧ್ಯದೇತ್ವದೊಳಮೀ
ತ್ವದೊಳಂ ತಾನತ್ವಮತ್ವಮಿರ್ದಂದುತ್ವಂ
ವಿದಿತಾತ್ವಕ್ಕಕ್ಕುಂ ಹ್ರ
ಸ್ವದೆತ್ವವಿಧಿ ಬಹುಳವೃತ್ತಿಯಿಂ ಕೆಲವೆಡೆಯೊಳ್
vrtti: ಪದಮಧ್ಯದೇಕಾರದೊಳಮೀಕಾರದೊಳಮತ್ವಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಪದಮಧ್ಯದತ್ವಕ್ಕುತ್ವಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಪದಮಧ್ಯದಾತ್ವಕ್ಕೆತ್ವಂ ಬಹುಳದಿನಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: In word-medial ē and ī, a itself [occurs]; where there is a, u; for the well-known ā, the rule of short e occurs variably in some places.
explanation_en: Medial ē and ī become a (ಅಲೇಖ→ಅಳಕ, ಕೌಪೀನ→ಕೋವಣ); medial a becomes u (ಸತ್ವಕ→ಸತ್ತುಗ); medial ā variably becomes short e (ರಸಾಯನ→ರಸೆಯನ, ಅನ್ಯಾಯ→ಅನ್ನೆಯ).

conditions: target: vowel of a non-initial syllable
rule.operation: replace ē → a, ī → a
also: replace a → u
replace ā → e (bahula, some places)

examples.note: medial a→u; from Kittel 1920; missing in venkat OCR
medial ā→e (bahula); from Kittel 1920; missing in venkat OCR

uncertain: pāda 1 `ದೇತ್ವದೊಳಮಾ` read `ದೇತ್ವದೊಳಮೀ` (vṛtti: ಏಕಾರದೊಳಮೀಕಾರದೊಳಂ)
venkat OCR has no example for a→u and only ರಸಾಯನ for ā→e (gap at ll. 19117–19122); ಸತ್ವಕ-ಸತ್ತುಗ and ಅನ್ಯಾಯ-ಅನ್ನೆಯ supplied from Kittel 1920

mula:
ಅವತರಿಸಿರ್ಕುಂ ಪದಮ
ಧ್ಯವರ್ಣದೊಳ್ ಲೋಪವೃತ್ತಿ ಬಹುಳತೆಯಿಂ ತ
ದ್ಭವಮಾದಿಯ ಬತ್ವಂ ಭೈ
ತ್ವಮೈತ್ವವಿಧಿಯತ್ವದಾತ್ವದೊಳ್ ದೊರೆಕೊಳ್ಳುಂ
vrtti: ಪದಮಧ್ಯದಕ್ಕರಕ್ಕೆ ಬಹುಳದಿಂ ಲೋಪಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಪದಾದಿಯ ಬಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಐತ್ವಂಬೆರಸಿದ ಭಕಾರಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಪದಾದಿಯತ್ವಕ್ಕಮಾತ್ವಕ್ಕಮೈತ್ವಮಕ್ಕುಂ. ಬಹುಳದಿನಿಲ್ಲಿ ಪದಮಧ್ಯಲೋಪಮಿಲ್ಲ.
english: Elision of a word-medial syllable occurs variably; in a tadbhava, the initial b becomes bhai; the rule of ai is found for a and ā.
explanation_en: (1) A medial syllable is variably dropped, often with contraction of the vowels around it (ಕುಮಾರ→ಕೋರ, ನವಮಿ→ನಾಮಿ, ಸಾಹಸ→ಸಾಸ). (2) Initial b becomes bhai in ಬಹಿತ್ರ→ಭೈತ್ರ. (3) Initial a / ā becomes ai when the following -hi-/-hy- is contracted (ಮಹಿಮ→ಮೈಮೆ, ವಾಹ್ಯಾಳಿ→ವೈಹಾಳಿ); in ವಾಹ್ಯಾಳಿ the medial loss does not happen (bahula).

conditions: word: Sanskrit word taken as tadbhava (specific words)
rule.operation: delete a medial syllable (bahula), contracting the adjacent vowels
also: replace initial b → bhai (ಬಹಿತ್ರ)
replace initial a/ā → ai (before contracted -hi-/-hyā-)

examples.note: medial syllable lost; variant 2: m→v and ā shortened instead; variant 1 of 2
medial syllable lost; variant 2: m→v and ā shortened instead; variant 2 of 2

mula:
ಸಮನಿಸುಗುಂ ಗತ್ವಂ ಶ
ಬ್ದಮಧ್ಯಮತ್ವಕ್ಕಮಂತೆ ಳತ್ವಕ್ಕಂ ಕ
ತ್ವಮದಿರ್ದೊಡೆ ವತ್ವಂ ಯ
ತ್ವಮಿಶ್ರಧತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ದತ್ವಮತ್ವಕ್ಕಿತ್ವಂ
vrtti: ಶಬ್ದಮಧ್ಯದ ಮಕಾರಕ್ಕಂ ಳಕಾರಕ್ಕಂ ಗಕಾರಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಪದಮಧ್ಯ ಕಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ವಕಾರಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಯತ್ವಮಿಶ್ರ ಧಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ದಕಾರಮಕ್ಕುಂ, ಅದಱತ್ವಕ್ಕಿತ್ವಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: g comes about for word-medial m, and likewise for ḷ; if it is k, v; for dh mixed with y, d; and for [its] a, i.
explanation_en: In medial position: m → g (ಯಮುನಾ→ಜಗುನೆ), ḷ → g (ಜಳೂಕಾ→ಜಿಗುಳೆ, with metathesis), k → v (ಶೀಕರ→ಸೀವರ); dhy → d(d) and the following a → i (ಅಧ್ಯಕ್ಷ→ಅದ್ದಿಕ).

conditions: target: consonant in a non-initial syllable (specific words)
rule.operation: replace medial m → g; medial ḷ → g
also: replace medial k → v
replace dhy → dd and the vowel a after it → i

examples.note: medial ḷ→g; also a→i, ḷ and g metathesis

uncertain: vṛtti `ಅದಳತ್ರಕ್ಕಿತ್ತಮಕ್ಕುಂ` read `ಅದಱತ್ವಕ್ಕಿತ್ವಮಕ್ಕುಂ` (Kittel `ಅದಲತ್ವಕ್ಕಿತ್ತಮಕ್ಕುಂ`)

mula:
ಪದಮಧ್ಯತಕಾರಕ್ಕ
ಪ್ಪುದೊರ್ಮೆ ರೇಫಂ ಟಕಾರಮೊರ್ಮೆ ಗಕಾರಂ
ಪುದಿದಿರ್ಕುಮೊರ್ಮೆ ತಾನಂ
ತ್ಯದೊಳೊಂದಿರೆ ಡತ್ವಮೊರ್ಮೆಯೊರ್ಮೆ ಹಕಾರಂ
vrtti: ಪದಮಧ್ಯ ತಕಾರಕ್ಕೊರ್ಮೆ ರೇಫಮುಂ ಟಕಾರಮುಂ ಗಕಾರಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಪದಾಂತ್ಯ ತಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಡಕಾರಮುಂ ಹಕಾರಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: For word-medial t, sometimes r, sometimes ṭ, sometimes g occurs; when it is at the end, sometimes ḍ, sometimes h.
explanation_en: Medial t becomes r (ಖಾತಿಕಾ→ಕಾರಿಗೆ), ṭ (ಪತ್ತನ→ಪಟ್ಟಣ) or g (ಅತಸಿ→ಅಗಸೆ, ಉತ್ಕಟ→ಉಗ್ಗಡ) in some words; t in the last syllable becomes ḍ (ಸಂಘಾತ→ಸಂಗಡ) or h (ತ್ವರಿತ→ತುರಿಹ).

conditions: target: t (specific words)
rule.operation: replace medial t → r | ṭ | g
also: replace t of the final syllable → ḍ | h

uncertain: Kittel o.r. adds ಗಾರಿಗೆ for ಖಾತಿಕಾ

mula:
ತಿಳಿ ಬಹುಳದೆ ಶಬ್ದಾಂತಂ
ಗಳ ನತ್ವಜ್ಞತ್ವಕತ್ವದೆಡೆಗೆ ಣಕಾರಂ
ತಳೆಗುಮದಂತಪದಾಂತಂ
ಗಳೆತ್ವಮುಮನಿತ್ವವೃತ್ತಿಯುಮನುತ್ವಮುಮಂ
vrtti: ಬಹುಳದಿಂ ಶಬ್ದಂಗಳ ಕಡೆಯ ನಕಾರ ಜ್ಞಕಾರ ಕಕಾರಂಗಳ್ಗೆ ಣತ್ವಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಪದಾಂತ್ಯದಕಾರಂಗಳ್ಗೆತ್ವಮುಮಿತ್ವಮುಮುತ್ವಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: Know: variably, ṇ [comes] in place of n, jñ and k at the ends of words; the ends of a-final words take e, i and u.
explanation_en: (1) In the last syllable n, jñ and k become ṇ (ಸ್ಥಾನ→ತಾಣ, ಆಜ್ಞಾ→ಆಣೆ, ನರ್ತಕಿ→ನಚ್ಚಣಿ); variably also medial n (ಶುನಕ→ಸೊಣಗ). (2) Words ending in -a take a final -e (ಚೀರ→ಸೀರೆ, ಕೋಕಿಲ→ಕೋಗಿಲೆ), -i (ಕಂಬಲ→ಕಂಬಳಿ, ಮಾಘ→ಮಾಗಿ) or -u (ದಂಡ→ದಂಡು, ಸ್ಫಟಿಕ→ಪಳಿಕು).

conditions: target: consonant of the word-final syllable; final vowel a
rule.operation: replace n → ṇ, jñ → ṇ, k → ṇ in the final syllable (bahula)
also: replace medial n → ṇ (bahula)
replace word-final a → e | i | u (lexical choice)

examples.note: final n→ṇ; footnote: cf. ಅಂಗಣವಾವಿ; Skt. also ಅಂಗಣ

`ಅರ್ಗಳ-ಅಗುಲ` read `ಅಗುೞಿ` (rule is a→i; Kittel `ಅಗುಖೌ`; Old Kannada ಅಗುೞಿ 'bolt')

mula:
ನೆಲೆಗೊಂಡುತ್ವಕ್ಕಿತ್ವಂ
ಕೆಲವೆಡೆಯಿತ್ವಕ್ಕಮುತ್ವಮುಂ ಹ್ರಸ್ವತೆಯ
ಗ್ಗಲಿಸಿರ್ದೆತ್ವಮುಮಂತ್ಯ
ಸ್ಥಲಸ್ವರಕ್ಕೊರ್ಮೆ ಲೋಪಮುಂ ಸಂಭವಿಕುಂ
vrtti: ಪದಾಂತ್ಯದುಕಾರಕ್ಕಿಕಾರಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಕೆಲವೆಡೆಯಿಕಾರಕ್ಕುಕಾರಮುಂ ಹ್ರಸ್ವಮಪ್ಪೆತ್ವಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಸ್ವರಕ್ಕೊರ್ಮೆ ಲೋಪಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: For the established [final] u, i; in some places, for i, u and also e marked by shortness; and for the vowel in final position, elision sometimes occurs.
explanation_en: Word-final vowels: final u becomes i (ಖರ್ಜು→ಕಜ್ಜಿ); final i sometimes becomes u (ಸಂಧಿ→ಸಂದು) or short e (ಸಪ್ತಮಿ→ಸತ್ತವೆ); and the final vowel is sometimes dropped, leaving a consonant-final Old Kannada word (ನೀರ→ನೀರ್, ಮುಕುಳ→ಮುಗುಳ್).
heading_en: Final u→i, i→u/e; final vowel dropped

conditions: target: word-final vowel
rule.operation: replace final u → i
also: replace final i → u | e (some words)
delete final vowel (sometimes), giving a consonant-final word (ನೀರ್, ಮಾನ್)

examples.note: final vowel deleted; venkat `ಸೇಲ್`, Kittel ಕೇಲ್
final vowel deleted; also m→v, medial ā shortened

mula:
ಮಹಿ ಪೊಗೞ್ದಾಶ್ಚರ್ಯಪ್ರ
ಗ್ರಹವಿಜ್ಞಾಪನಕಪಿಂಜಳಾಂಗಿರಸಾಂತ್ಯ
ಕ್ಕೆ ಹಿತಂ ಲೋಪವಿಧಾನಂ
ಗ್ರಹಣಕ್ಕಂ ಗರಣಮಾಯ್ತು ಶಬ್ದಾದೇಶಂ
vrtti: ಈ ಶಬ್ದಂಗಳ ಕಡೆಯಕ್ಕರಕ್ಕೆ ಲೋಪಂ; ಗ್ರಹಣಶಬ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಗರಣಮೆಂದಾದೇಶಂ.
english: Elision is proper for the final [syllable] of āścarya, pragraha, vijñāpana, kapiñjaḷa and āṅgirasa, praised by the world; and for grahaṇa the word-substitute garaṇa came about.
explanation_en: In the listed words the last syllable is dropped (ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯ→ಅಚ್ಚರಿ, ವಿಜ್ಞಾಪನ→ಬಿನ್ನಪ, ಆಂಗಿರಸ→ಆಂಗಿರ); other regular changes co-occur. ಗ್ರಹಣ is replaced as a whole by ಗರಣ.
heading_en: Final syllable lost in listed words; grahaṇa→garaṇa

conditions: words: ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯ, ಪ್ರಗ್ರಹ, ವಿಜ್ಞಾಪನ, ಕಪಿಂಜಳ, ಆಂಗಿರಸ (listed)
rule.operation: delete the final syllable (antyākṣara-lōpa)
also: substitute the whole word: ಗ್ರಹಣ → ಗರಣ (śabdādēśa)

examples.note: final syllable deleted; also ā shortened, ścary→cc+i
final syllable deleted; also pr→h, gr→gg

mula:
ಕೂರಪ್ರಾಕಾರಂಗಳ
ಮೇರೆಯ ರೇಫಕ್ಕೆ ತರದೆ ಱೞಲತ್ವಂಗಳ್
ಪೂರಿಪುವಸ್ವರವಿಧಿಯಿಂ
ಸಾರಂ ಗ್ರಾಮಾಣಣತ್ವದೆಡೆಗೆ ಲಕಾರಂ
vrtti: ಕೂರ ಪ್ರಾಕಾರಂಗಳ ರೇಫೆಗೆ ಪರಿವಿಡಿಯಿಂ ಱೞಮುಂ ಲಕಾರಮುಂ ವ್ಯಂಜನರೂಪದಿನಕ್ಕುಂ; ಗ್ರಾಮಾಣಶಬ್ದದ ಣಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಲಕಾರಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: For the final repha of kūra and prākāra, ṟ/ḻ and l respectively complete [the word] by the rule of being vowelless; the excellent l [comes] in the place of the ṇ of grāmāṇa.
explanation_en: Word-specific: the final -ra of ಕೂರ (Skt kūra, boiled rice) becomes the vowelless ḻ / ṟ (ಕೂೞ್), that of ಪ್ರಾಕಾರ becomes vowelless l (ಪಾಗಲ್); in ಗ್ರಾಮಾಣ the ṇ becomes l (ಗಾವಿಲ, 'rustic').

conditions: words: ಕೂರ, ಪ್ರಾಕಾರ (final r); ಗ್ರಾಮಾಣ (ṇ)
rule.operation: replace final ra → ṟ/ḻ (vowelless) in ಕೂರ; final ra → l (vowelless) in ಪ್ರಾಕಾರ
also: replace ṇ → l in ಗ್ರಾಮಾಣ

examples.note: also pr→p, k→g, medial ā shortened

mula:
ಶ ಸ ದ ಧ ಲ ಜ ಳ ತದಿಂ ಕೆಳ
ಗೆ ಸಲ್ವ ವತ್ವಂ ಸ್ನುಕಾರನತ್ವಂ ಮತ್ತಂ
ಜ ಸ ಕ ನ ವ ಶ ಷದ ಯತ್ವಂ
ಪ್ರಸನ್ನಭಾವದೊಳೆ ತಳ್ತು ಲೋಪಮನಾಳ್ಗುಂ
vrtti: ಶಕಾರ ಸಕಾರ ದಕಾರ ಧಕಾರ ಲಕಾರ ಜಕಾರ ಳಕಾರ ತಕಾರದ ಕೆಳಗಣ ವತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಲೋಪಂ; ಸ್ನುಕಾರದ ನಕಾರಕ್ಕಂ ಲೋಪಂ; ಜಕಾರ ಸಕಾರ ಕಕಾರ ನಕಾರ ವಕಾರ ಶಕಾರ ಷಕಾರದ ಕೆಳಗಿರ್ದ ಯತ್ವಕ್ಕಂ ಲೋಪಂ.
english: The v that stands below ś, s, d, dh, l, j, ḷ, t; the n of snu; and further the y of j, s, k, n, v, ś, ṣ — these clearly undergo elision.
explanation_en: Simplification without gemination: the second member v is simply dropped after ś s d dh l j ḷ t (ಈಶ್ವರ→ಈಸರ, ದ್ವೀಪ→ದೀಪ, ಜ್ವರ→ಜರ); the n of snu- is dropped (ಸ್ನುಷಾ→ಸೊಸೆ); the y after j s k n v ś ṣ is dropped (ನ್ಯೂನ→ನೂನ, ಸಸ್ಯ→ಸಸಿ, ಶ್ಯಾಮ→ಸಾಮ). Compare 266, where similar clusters geminate instead (ಕನ್ಯಕಾ→ಕನ್ನಿಕೆ): the choice is lexical.
heading_en: Loss of v, y (and n of snu) after consonants

conditions: target: cluster C+v with C ∈ {ś, s, d, dh, l, j, ḷ, t}; cluster s+n in snu-; cluster C+y with C ∈ {j, s, k, n, v, ś, ṣ}
rule.operation: delete v (no gemination)
also: delete n of snu (ಸ್ನು→ಸು)
delete y (no gemination); vowel often modified (yā→e/ē, y+ō→ō)

examples.note: v deleted; printed ಬಿಳ್ಳ; Kittel: o.r.

`ಮಾಣಿಕ್ಕ-ಮಾಣಿಕ` read input `ಮಾಣಿಕ್ಯ` (Kittel)

mula:
ಯತ್ವದ ಸತ್ವದ ಚತ್ವದ
ದತ್ವದ ವಿಧಿ ಜತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಭವಿಸಿರ್ಕುಂ
ಭತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಹ ಪ ವಮಕ್ಕುಂ
ರತ್ವಕ್ಕಂ ಲ ಳಮುಮಕ್ಕುಮೋರೊಂದೆಡೆಯೊಳ್
vrtti: ಯತ್ವಮುಂ ಸತ್ವಮುಂ ಚತ್ವಮುಂ ದತ್ವಮುಂ ಜತ್ವಕ್ಕಾದೇಶಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಭತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಹತ್ವಮುಂ ಪತ್ವಮುಂ ವತ್ವಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ರೇಫೆಗೆ ಲತ್ವಮುಂ ಳತ್ವಮುಂ ಕಿಱಿದೆಡೆಯೊಳಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: The rules of y, s, c and d occur in the case of j; for bh, h, p and v occur; and for r, l and ḷ occur, in a place here and there.
explanation_en: j becomes y (ರಾಜ→ರಾಯ), s (ಕುಟಜಕ→ಕೊಡಸಿಗೆ), d (ಮುಂಜ→ಮೊದೆ) or c (ಲಾಮಜ್ಜ→ಲಾಮಚ್ಚ); bh becomes h (ವಲ್ಲಭ→ಬಲ್ಲಹ), p (ಭಿಂಡಿವಾಳ→ಪಿಂಡಿವಾಳ) or v (ವೃಷಭ→ಬಸವ); r becomes l (ಕುಠಾರ→ಕೊಡಲಿ) or ḷ (ಮರೀಚ→ಮೆಳಸು) in a few words.

conditions: word: specific tadbhava words
rule.operation: replace j → y | s | d | c

mula:
ಡತ್ವಂ ಜತ್ವಂ ದ್ವಿತ್ವಾ
ದ್ವಿತ್ವಧಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಯೋಗವಾಹಮನಾಳ್ದಾ
ಷತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಡತ್ವಟತ್ವಂ
ದ್ವಿತ್ವದಿನಕ್ಕುಂ ಟಕಾರಮೊರ್ಮದ್ವಿತ್ವಂ
vrtti: ದ್ವಿತ್ವಮುಮದ್ವಿತ್ವಮುಮಪ್ಪ ಧಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ತದನುರೂಪಮಾಗಿ ಡಕಾರಮುಂ ಜಕಾರಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಆ ಯೋಗವಾಹದ ಷತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ದ್ವಿತ್ವದ ಡಕಾರಮುಂ ಟಕಾರಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ದ್ವಿತ್ವರಹಿತಮಪ್ಪ ಟತ್ವಮೊರ್ಮೆಯಕ್ಕುಂ. (ಪದ್ಧತಿಯೆಂಬ ಶಬ್ದದ ತಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಲೋಪಮುಂಟು.)
english: For doubled and undoubled dh, ḍ and j [occur]; for that ṣ which carries a yogavāha [i.e. stands in a cluster], ḍ and ṭ with doubling occur; ṭ sometimes without doubling.
explanation_en: (1) dh in a geminate/cluster (ddh) becomes ḍḍ (ವರ್ಧಕಿ→ಬಡ್ಡಗಿ) or jj (ಪದ್ಧತಿ→ಪಜ್ಜೆ, with loss of the t-syllable); single dh becomes j (ಧಾತು→ಜಾದು). (2) ṣ in the clusters ṣṭ/ṣṭh becomes geminate ḍḍ (ಕಾಷ್ಠ→ಕಡ್ಡಿ) or ṭṭ (ಕಷ್ಟ→ಕಟ್ಟ, ಪಿಷ್ಟ→ಹಿಟ್ಟು); sometimes single ṭ without doubling (ಜ್ಯೇಷ್ಠಾ→ಜೇಟೆ, ಸೌರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ→ಸೊರಟ).

conditions: target: dh (geminate/clustered or single); cluster ṣṭ / ṣṭh
rule.operation: replace ddh/rdh → ḍḍ (also ḍ) | jj; single dh → j
also: replace ṣṭ, ṣṭh → ḍḍ | ṭṭ
replace ṣṭ, ṣṭh → ṭ (single, sometimes)

examples.note: ṣṭ(h)→ṭ (no doubling); variant 2 as printed; variant 1 of 2
ṣṭ(h)→ṭ (no doubling); variant 2 as printed; variant 2 of 2

mula:
ವಿದಿತಂ ದಾಡಿಮಕೂಷ್ಮಾಂ
ಡದ ಮತ್ವಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬತ್ವಂ ಕೂಷ್ಮಾಂ
ಡದ ಷತ್ವಕ್ಕಂ ಬಿಂದುಗ
ಮುದಯಿಸುಗುಂ ಲೋಪವೃತ್ತಿ ಲಕ್ಷಣವಿಧಿಯಿಂ
vrtti: ದಾಡಿಮ ಕೂಷ್ಮಾಂಡಂಗಳ ಮತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಬತ್ವಂ; ಕೂಷ್ಮಾಂಡದ ಷಕಾರಕ್ಕಂ ಬಿಂದುಗಂ ಲೋಪಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: It is known that b [comes] in the place of the m of dāḍima and kūṣmāṇḍa; for the ṣ of kūṣmāṇḍa and for the anusvāra, elision arises by the rule of the grammar.
explanation_en: Word-specific: the m of ದಾಡಿಮ and ಕೂಷ್ಮಾಂಡ becomes b; in ಕೂಷ್ಮಾಂಡ the ṣ and the anusvāra (of -māṇḍa) are deleted (ಕುಂಬಳ). ದಾಡಿಮ→ದಾಳಿಂಬ also shows ḍ→ḷ and an inserted anusvāra (285).

conditions: words: ದಾಡಿಮ, ಕೂಷ್ಮಾಂಡ
rule.operation: replace m → b
also: ಕೂಷ್ಮಾಂಡ: delete ṣ and the anusvāra of -māṇḍa

examples.note: m→b; also ū shortened, anusvāra moved to first syllable (285), ḍ→ḷ

mula:
ಸಮನಿಸುಗುಮಾದಿವರ್ಣಾಂ-
ತಿಮದೊಳಮೆರಡನೆಯ ವರ್ಣದಂತಿಮದೊಳಮಾ
ಸಮುಚಿತಬಿಂದುಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಬಿಂ-
ದುಮಂತಶಬ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಬಿಂದುಲೋಪಂ ಬಹುಳಂ
vrtti: ಮೊದಲಕ್ಕರದ ಕಡೆಯೊಳಮೆರಡನೆಯಕ್ಕರದ ಕಡೆಯೊಳಮುಚಿತಮಾಗಿ ಬಿಂದುವಕ್ಕುಂ; ಬಿಂದುಯುಕ್ತಶಬ್ದಂಗಳ್ಗೆ ಬಹುಳದಿಂ ಲೋಪಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: At the end of the first syllable and at the end of the second syllable a fitting bindu (anusvāra) comes to stand; for a word that has a bindu, loss of the bindu takes place variably (bahuḷa).
explanation_en: Two tadbhava rules about the anusvāra (bindu). (1) When a Sanskrit word is turned into a tadbhava, an anusvāra may be inserted after the first syllable (kūṣmāṇḍa → kumbaḷa, tāta → tande, markaṭa → maṅkaḍa, mēthi → mēṇṭi) or after the second syllable (kramuka → kavuṅgu, dāḍima → dāḷimba); this is 'ucita', i.e. lexically governed, not automatic. (2) A Sanskrit word that already contains an anusvāra variably loses it in the tadbhava (muñja → mode, vāṃśya → vāsa, lāñchana → laccaṇa, saṃskṛta → sakkada), but often keeps it (aṅkuśa → aṅkusa, manthani → mantaṇi, saṅghāta → saṅgaḍa). markaṭa also has the bindu-less variant makkaḍa.
heading_en: Anusvāra insertion and loss in tadbhavas

conditions: input: Sanskrit (tatsama) word being converted to tadbhava
position: end of syllable 1 or end of syllable 2
lexically listed (ucita), not productive
rule.operation: insert anusvāra (ಂ) after syllable 1 or syllable 2 (the following stop then usually becomes the homorganic voiced/nasal-cluster form, e.g. ṣmā→mba, ḍi→ḷi+mba)
also: input: Sanskrit word containing anusvāra → delete anusvāra (bahula: optional, word-specific; otherwise keep it)

examples.note: bindu after 1st syllable; Kittel 1920 reads ಮೇಠಿ (other reading ಮೇಧಿ)

mula:
ಪದದೆರಡನೆಯಕ್ಕರದ-
ತ್ವದೊಳೆತ್ವಂ ಹ್ರಸ್ವದೆತ್ವಮಾತ್ವಕ್ಕೂತ್ವ-
ಕ್ಕುದಯಿಕುಮತ್ವಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಬಹು-
ಳದೆ ದೀರ್ಘಂ ಹ್ರಸ್ವಮಾ ತೃತೀಯಾಕ್ಷರಕಂ
vrtti: ಪದದೆರಡನೆಯಕ್ಕರದತ್ವಕ್ಕೆತ್ವಮುಮಾಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಹ್ರಸ್ವೈತ್ವಮುಮೂಕಾರಕ್ಕತ್ವಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಆ ದ್ವಿತೀಯಾಕ್ಷರದೀರ್ಘಕ್ಕೆ ಹ್ರಸ್ವಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ತೃತೀಯಾಕ್ಷರಕ್ಕಮಂತೆ.
english: In the second syllable of a word, a becomes e; ā becomes short e; for ū, a arises; variably (bahuḷa) a long vowel becomes short — and so also for the third syllable.
explanation_en: Vowel changes in the 2nd syllable of a Sanskrit word when it becomes a tadbhava: a → e (ujjayini → ujjeṇi), ā → short e (rasāyana → raseyana), ū → a (nirūpisida → niravisida). Further, a long vowel in the 2nd syllable is (variably) shortened (amāvāsyā → avase, udyāpana → ujjavaṇe, tṛtīyā → tadige, dvitīyā → bidige, prasādhana → pasadana, vināyaka → benaka, hiṅgūlaka → iṅgulika), and likewise a long vowel in the 3rd syllable (uttarīyaka → uttarige, vardhamāna → baddavaṇa). These pairs also show other changes (consonant softening, syllable loss) covered by neighbouring rules.

conditions: input: Sanskrit word → tadbhava
position: vowel of syllable 2 (and, for shortening, syllable 3)
rule.operation: syllable 2: replace a→e; replace ā→e (short); replace ū→a
also: syllable 2: long vowel → shorten (bahula)
syllable 3: long vowel → shorten (bahula)

mula:
ವ್ಯವಹರಿಸುಗುಮತ್ವಕ್ಕಿ-
ತ್ವವಿಧಾನಂ ಹ್ರಸ್ವದೊತ್ವಮುತ್ವಂ ಶಬ್ದ-
ಪ್ರವಿದಿತಮಾದುತ್ವಕ್ಕ-
ತ್ವವೃತ್ತಿ ಮೂಱನೆಯ ವರ್ಣದೊಳ್ ನೆಲೆಗೊಳ್ಳುಂ
vrtti: ಶಬ್ದಂಗಳ ತೃತೀಯಾಕ್ಷರದತ್ವಕ್ಕಿತ್ವಮುಂ ಹ್ರಸ್ವೋತ್ವಮುಂ ಉತ್ವಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಉತ್ವಕ್ಕತ್ವಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: For a, the prescription of i operates, and short o and u; for the u that is well known in words, the occurrence of a — this takes hold in the third syllable.
explanation_en: Vowel changes in the 3rd syllable of a Sanskrit word becoming tadbhava: a → i (hiṅgūlaka → iṅgulika), a → short o (suraparṇi → surahonne), a → u (ālasyaka → alasuge); and u → a (kustumburu → kottumbari, where the 3rd-syllable u becomes a). The choice among i/o/u is lexical.

conditions: input: Sanskrit word → tadbhava
position: vowel of syllable 3
rule.operation: replace a→i | a→o (short) | a→u (lexically chosen)
also: syllable 3: replace u→a

mula:
ದೊರೆಕೊಳ್ಳುಂ ನಾಲ್ಕನೆಯ-
ಕ್ಕರದತ್ವಕ್ಕೋತ್ವವೃತ್ತಿ ಶಬ್ದಂಗಳೊಳಿ-
ರ್ದೆರಡನೆಯ ಮೂಱನೆಯ ಸಂ-
ಚರಿಸುವ ನಾಲ್ಕನೆಯ ವರ್ಣಮಕ್ಕುಮಭಾವಂ
vrtti: ನಾಲ್ಕನೆಯಕ್ಕರದತ್ವಕ್ಕೋತ್ವಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಶಬ್ದಂಗಳೊಳಿರ್ದೆರಡನೆಯ ಮೂಱನೆಯ ನಾಲ್ಕನೆಯಕ್ಕರಕ್ಕೆ ಲೋಪಂ.
english: For the a of the fourth syllable, o comes about; the second, third or fourth syllable occurring in words becomes absent (is dropped).
explanation_en: (1) In the 4th syllable of a Sanskrit word, a → o in the tadbhava (āṭarūṣaka → āḍasōge). (2) A whole syllable — the 2nd, 3rd or 4th — may be deleted: 2nd (vyavahāra → bēhāra), 3rd (amāvāsyā → avase, āṭarūṣaka → āḍasōge, ujjayini → ujjeṇi, palyayana → hallaṇa, maruvaka → maruga, vināyaka → benaka). Kittel 1920 also gives a 4th-syllable loss: uttarīyaka → uttarige.

conditions: input: Sanskrit word → tadbhava
rule.operation: syllable 4: replace a→o
also: delete syllable 2, 3 or 4 (lexically determined)

examples.note: 3rd syllable dropped; Kittel notes variant ಮರಗ
4th syllable dropped — example only in Kittel 1920

uncertain: vowel length: Venkat ಓತ್ವ / ಆಡಸೋಗೆ (long), Kittel 1920 ಒತ್ವ / ಆಡಸೊಗೆ (short)

mula:
ಪದನೆರಡುಂ ತದ್ಭವದೊಳ್
ಪುದಿದಿರೆ ಮಾೞ್ಪುದು ಸಮಾಸಮಂ ಪದಯುಗದೊಳ್
ಪದಮೊಂದೇಗೆಯ್ದುಂ ವಿಧಿ-
ಗೊದವದೆ ನಿಲೆಯುಂ ಸಮಾಸಮುಂಟರೆಯೆಡೆಯೊಳ್
vrtti: ಎರಡು ಪದಂಗಳಪಭ್ರಂಶದೊಳ್ ನಿಲೆ, ಸಮಾಸಮಂ ಮಾೞ್ಪುದು; ಎರಡು ಪದಂಗಳೊಳೊಂದು ಪದನಪಭ್ರಂಶಲಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೆ ಬಾರದೆ ನಿಜದಿನಿರೆಯುಂ ನಿರ್ದೋಷಮಾಗಿ ಕಿಱಿದೆಡೆಯೊಳ್ ಸಮಾಸಮುಂಟು.
english: When both words are fitted into tadbhava form, make the compound; of the pair, even when one word, whatever be done, does not come under the rule and stays [as it is], a compound exists in a few places.
explanation_en: Compounding of tadbhavas. (1) Normal case: both members are tadbhavas (sarvalakṣaṇa → sabbalakkaṇa). (2) Allowed in some attested cases: one member stays unaltered Sanskrit while the other is tadbhava — either the first member is unaltered and the second is tadbhava (pañcaśara → pañcasara, karaṇaśālā → karaṇasāle) or the first is tadbhava and the second unaltered (paśupati → pasupati, triguṇa → tiguṇa). (3) Fault: where both members could be tadbhavas, keeping one in Sanskrit form next to a tadbhava is wrong — Haṃsarāja's māṇikyabhaṇḍāra is faulty; correct is māṇikabhaṇḍāra.

conditions: left and right: Sanskrit words converted to tadbhava
rule.operation: convert each member to its tadbhava and compound them (both members tadbhava = default)
also: mixed compound (one member unaltered tatsama, other tadbhava) allowed only where attested (ಕಿಱಿದೆಡೆ 'in a few places')
if a tadbhava exists for a member, do NOT keep it in tatsama form beside a tadbhava (ಮಾಣಿಕ್ಯಭಂಡಾರ ✗ → ಮಾಣಿಕಭಂಡಾರ ✓)

counterexamples.why: ಮಾಣಿಕ್ಯ has a tadbhava (ಮಾಣಿಕ); keeping the tatsama beside the tadbhava ಭಂಡಾರ is a fault (Haṃsarāja's usage); correct ಮಾಣಿಕಭಂಡಾರ

mula:
ಏಕದ್ವಿತ್ರಿಚತುಃಶ-
ಬ್ದಾಕೃತಿಗೆಕ್ಕ ದು ತಿ ಚೌಗಳಾದೇಶಂಗಳ್
ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಸಮಾಸಪೂರ್ವದೊ-
ಳಾಕರಿಪರ್ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯಾಂತದೊಳಮೀ ವಿಧಿಯಂ
vrtti: ಸಮಾಸದಾದಿಯೊಳಿರ್ದ ಏಕ ದ್ವಿ ತ್ರಿ ಚತುಃಶಬ್ದಂಗಳ್ಗೆ ಎಕ್ಕ ದು ತಿ ಚೌ ಎಂಬಿವಾದೇಶಮಪ್ಪುವು; ದ್ವಿ ತ್ರಿ ಚತುಃಶಬ್ದಂಗಳ್ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯಾಂತಮಾದೊಡಂ ಈ ಲಕ್ಷಣಮೆ.
english: For the forms of the words eka, dvi, tri, catuḥ, ekka, du, ti, cau are the substitutes when they stand as the first member of an accepted compound; [grammarians] apply this rule also when they end in a suffix.
explanation_en: Numeral substitution in tadbhava compounds: as first member of a compound, Sanskrit eka → ekka, dvi → du (also dū), tri → ti, catuḥ/catur → cau. The same substitution applies when dvi/tri/catur carry a suffix: dvika → duga, trika → tiga, catuṣka → cauka. The second member undergoes its own tadbhava changes (e.g. p → v by 292).

conditions: left (first member of a tadbhava compound): ಏಕ | ದ್ವಿ | ತ್ರಿ | ಚತುಃ/ಚತುರ್

ಬ್ದಮೆ ಸಾಮಾದೇಶದಿಂ ಸಮಾಸಾದಿಯೊಳಂ-

english: The well-established words saha and mahat, at the beginning of a compound, are fitted with the substitutes sā and mā, when the beginning of the following word joins with a consonant — variably.
explanation_en: At the start of a tadbhava compound, saha → sā and mahat/mahā → mā when the second member begins with a consonant: sahadēva → sādēva, mahādēva → mādēva. bahula: some compounds keep the Sanskrit form (mahāgaja, mahāgiri, mahāsainya, sahajāta, sahadharmi, sahabhōji).

ಸಿರೆ ವತ್ವಂ ಪೀನಮಾ ಪಕಾರಮದೂತ್ವಂ
ಬೆರಸಿರೆ ತಾಂ ಹ್ರಸ್ವತೆಯಂ-
ತರೆಂಬ ಶಬ್ದಾಂತರೇಫೆಗಕ್ಕುಂ ಲೋಪಂ
vrtti: ಪರಪದದ ಮೊದಲೊಳ್ ಪಕಾರ ಬಕಾರ ಮಕಾರಂಗಳಿರೆ ವತ್ವಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಆ ಪಕಾರದೂತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಹ್ರಸ್ವಮಪ್ಪುಕಾರಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಅಂತರ್ಶಬ್ದದ ಕಡೆಯ ರೇಫೆಗೆ ಲೋಪಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: When p, b, m stand in the following word, v comes — abundantly; when that p is joined with ū, it becomes short; the final r of the word antar is dropped.
explanation_en: In tadbhava compounds, an initial p, b or m of the second member becomes v (candrapura → candavura, śarabandha → saravanda, ratnamaṇi → rannavaṇi). When that p carried ū, the ū is shortened to u (karṇapūra → kannavura). The final r (visarga) of antar is dropped (antaḥpura → antavura). 'pīna' (abundantly, i.e. not always): some compounds keep p/b/m (accamallige, nibbuddi, akkaramāle, hadibade, kaṇḍapaṭa, baḷḷimāḍa, gujjarapaṭṭi, saṅkarapasāyita, nibbandiga).
heading_en: p/b/m → v at start of second member

conditions: right (second member of tadbhava compound) begins with ಪ, ಬ or ಮ

left = ಅಂತರ್/ಅಂತಃ: delete final ರ್/visarga (ಅಂತಃಪುರ→ಅಂತವುರ)

ಳ್ವುದು ದೀರ್ಘಂ ಪೂರ್ವಪದಾಂ-
ತ್ಯದೊಳುತ್ತರಪದದ ಮೊದಲೊಳೊದವಿರೆ ಲೋಪಂ
vrtti: ಪೂರ್ವೋಕ್ತಸೂತ್ರದಿಂ ಪರದ ಕ ತ ಪಕ್ಕೆ ತೃತೀಯತೆಯಕ್ಕುಂ; ಪೂರ್ವಪದಾಂತ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ದೀರ್ಘಮುಮುತ್ತರಪದದಾದಿಗೆ ಲೋಪಮುಮಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: By the rule of the earlier sūtra, 'third-ness' (voicing) arises for k, t, p; lengthening attaches to the end of the first word when loss occurs at the beginning of the second word.
explanation_en: In tadbhava compounds, (1) an initial k, t, p of the second member becomes the third consonant of its class, i.e. g, d, b, by the earlier (Sandhi-chapter) rule of initial voicing in compounds: karpūrakaraṇḍaka → kappuragaraḍage, mālātōraṇa → māledōraṇa (p→b examples are to be found in usage). (2) When the initial syllable of the second member is lost, the final vowel of the first member is lengthened: kāṃsyatāḷa → kaṃsāḷa, dharmapānīya → dammāṇi.
heading_en: Initial voicing of k/t/p; lengthening with loss

conditions: right (second member of tadbhava compound) begins with ಕ | ತ | ಪ
rule.operation: replace initial ಕ→ಗ, ತ→ದ, ಪ→ಬ (tṛtīya = 3rd consonant of the varga), per the earlier sandhi rule
also: if the initial syllable of the second member is deleted: lengthen final vowel of first member (ಕಂಸ+ತಾಳ → ಕಂಸಾಳ; ದಮ್ಮ+ಪಾಣಿ → ದಮ್ಮಾಣಿ)

english: Always, when ākāra, āgāra and āvaḷikā become the second member of a compound, loss takes hold — on reflection, in their second syllable and in their first.
explanation_en: When ākāra, āgāra or āvaḷikā is the second member of a tadbhava compound, its second syllable is lost: -ākāra → -āra (citrākāra → cittāra), -āgāra → -āra (bhāṇḍāgāra → bhaṇḍāra), -āvaḷikā → -āḷige (dīpāvaḷikā → dīpāḷige). Alternatively the first syllable (the ā, together with the preceding syllable it merged with) is lost: dīpāvaḷikā → dīvaḷige. bahula: siṃhāgāra and kārāgāra do not undergo this.

ಯ್ಯೊಕ್ಕ ನಿಧಿಯೆನಿಪಪಭ್ರಂ-

vrtti: ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಮಂ ಮಱೆಗೊಳ್ಳದೆ ನೆಱೆವಣಿಗೆಯಿಂದಚ್ಚಗನ್ನಡಮಂ ಪೇೞ್ವರ್ಗೀಯಪಭ್ರಂಶಪದಮುಂ ಇದಱ ಸಮಾಸಮುಂ ತತ್ಸಮದ ಸಮಾಸಮುಂ ಕಯ್ಯೊಕ್ಕ ನಿಧಾನಂ; ಇದಱೊಡನೆ ಕನ್ನಡದ ದೇಶೀಯಪದಮಂ ಸಮಾಸಿಸಲಪ್ಪುದು.
english: For apabhraṃśa (tadbhava), which is a treasure fallen into the hands of those who desire pure Kannada with elegance without hiding behind Sanskrit, and for dēśya words, there is compounding.
explanation_en: Tadbhava words, tadbhava compounds and tatsama compounds (of the 297–298 type) may be compounded with native dēśya Kannada words. Three patterns: tadbhava + dēśya (rāya+kōṇṭe → rāyagōṇṭe), tadbhava compound + dēśya (tāṇadīvige+beḷagu → tāṇadīvigeveḷagu), tatsama compound + dēśya (kaṭṭaṅka+dallaṇa → kaṭṭaṅkadallaṇa). Normal Kannada compound sandhi applies to the second member (k/t → g/d, b/m → v). This contrasts with pure Sanskrit tatsamas, which may not be mixed with dēśya words (arisamāsa).
heading_en: Tadbhavas may compound with dēśya words

ವನೆಯೆಂಬೆರಡುಂ ಪದಾಂತ್ಯದೊಳ್ ಬರೆಯುಂ ನೆ-

vrtti: ಧಿಗಿಲನೆ, ಭುಗಿಲನೆ, ಭೋರನೆ ಎಂಬನುಕರಣಪದಂಗಳ್ ಬರೆಯುಂ, ಅದು ಅನೆ ಎಂಬಿವು ಪದಾಂತಂಗಳೊಳಿರೆಯುಂ, ಅವ್ಯಯಪದಂಗಳಪ್ಪುವು.
english: When onomatopoeic words occur, and when the two [endings] adu and ane come at the end of a word, they are plainly avyayas; the n of ane optionally becomes g.
explanation_en: Defines three classes of avyaya: (1) onomatopoeic/imitative words (anukṛti) such as dhigilane, bhugilane, bhōrane; (2) words ending in -adu (nūṅkadu, nūḷadu, tettadu); (3) words ending in -ane (kammane, immane, siyyane, mellane). In -ane words the n optionally becomes g, giving -age: neṭṭane/neṭṭage, summane/summage, kammane/kammage, binnane/binnage. Such words are not declined.

conditions: word is onomatopoeic (anukṛti) | word ends in ಅದು | word ends in ಅನೆ
rule.operation: assign class avyaya (indeclinable; no case/number inflection)
also: word ending in ಅನೆ: optionally replace final ನೆ → ಗೆ (ಅನೆ → ಅಗೆ)

ರ್ಥೋಲ್ಲಸಿತಂ ನಿರ್ನಿರೆಂಬುದುಂ ನಿರ್ನೆರಮುಂ
english: In a sentence, 'illa' is an avyaya of verbal nature; 'kīṟidu' has the sense 'crowded'; for the learned, 'nirnir' and 'nirneram' shine in the sense 'without cause'.
explanation_en: illa 'is not, there is not' functions in the sentence as a verbal (predicative) avyaya — it is uninflected yet serves as the finite predicate of negation. kīṟidu means 'crowded, thronged' (ākīrṇa). nirnir and nirneram mean 'causelessly, for no reason'.

conditions: avyaya ∈ {ಇಲ್ಲ, ಕೀಱಿದು, ನಿರ್ನಿರ್, ನಿರ್ನೆರಂ}
rule.operation: assign meanings: ಇಲ್ಲ = negation, used as a finite verbal predicate (kriyātmaka avyaya); ಕೀಱಿದು = crowded; ನಿರ್ನಿರ್, ನಿರ್ನೆರಂ = without cause

explanation_en: Avyayas of silence: summage, summane, usikaṃ (or usikane) 'silently'. Avyayas of inactivity (doing nothing, motionless): guṟugummage, binnage, binnane.

ಆನುಮೆನಿಪ್ಪವ್ಯಯಮಂ
ಸ್ಥಾನದಿಶಾಕಾಲಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳೊಳುಸಿರ್ವರ್ ಮ-
ತ್ತೇನುಮೆನಿಪ್ಪರ್ಥಮನಿರ-
ದಾನಿಪರಣಮಾಣಮೆಂದು ನುಡಿವವ್ಯಯದೊಳ್
english: They use the avyaya ānum with place, direction, time and number; further, they apply without hesitation the sense 'ēnum' (anything) in the avyayas spoken as aṇaṃ and āṇaṃ.
explanation_en: ānuṃ is suffixed to interrogative/indefinite words of place (elli → elliyānuṃ 'anywhere'), direction (ettu → ettānuṃ 'in any direction'), time (endu → endānuṃ 'at any time') and to numerals (ondānuṃ 'even one / some one', eraḍānuṃ, pattānuṃ, nūṟānuṃ 'about/any ten, hundred'). aṇaṃ and āṇaṃ carry the sense of ēnuṃ 'anything at all', used with negation: kāryamaṇamilla 'there is no business whatsoever', guṇamāṇamilla 'there is no merit at all'.

conditions: left: word of place (ಎಲ್ಲಿ), direction (ಎತ್ತ), time (ಎಂದು) or a numeral
right: avyaya ಆನುಂ
rule.operation: add ಆನುಂ (vowel sandhi: final vowel of left elided; ಎಲ್ಲಿ+ಆನುಂ → ಎಲ್ಲಿಯಾನುಂ with y-insertion after i) → indefinite 'any-, some-, even'
also: ಅಣಂ / ಆಣಂ after a noun (noun takes final ಮ್ before vowel: ಕಾರ್ಯಂ+ಅಣಂ → ಕಾರ್ಯಮಣಂ) = 'anything at all', with ಇಲ್ಲ

meaning of ಆಣಂ: 'anything at all' — 'there is no merit at all' (ಏನುಮಿಲ್ಲೆಂಬರ್ಥಂ)

ತಾಗುಗುಮತಿನಿಶ್ಚಯಾರ್ಥಮಂ ತಾನಿತರಾ-

explanation_en: ēgaṃ, valaṃ, veṟaṃ, dal express emphatic certainty ('surely, indeed, certainly'). mattina means 'other, another'. bēṟe bēṟe means 'separately, each apart'. (Bhāṣābhūṣaṇa, per Kittel: ēgaṃ = viniścaya; veṟaṃ, valaṃ = vispaṣṭa; dal = vākyālaṅkāra, pādapūraṇa, viniścaya.)

ಸ್ಫುರಿತಾರ್ಥದೊಳುಃ ಎಂಬುದು
ಪಿರಿದುಮಸಹ್ಯಾರ್ಥದೊಳ್ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಿಸೆಪಡುಗುಂ
english: In order, the two āḥ and aḥ [are used] in the sense of suddenly flashing wonder, mockery and distress; uḥ is used greatly in the sense of the unbearable.
explanation_en: āḥ and aḥ express a sudden feeling of astonishment, mockery or distress; uḥ expresses disgust or the intolerable. Kittel's text instead reads '…vismaya-viḍambanaṃ, vyasana-sukha-sphuritārthadoḷ uḥ…': āḥ = astonishment, aḥ = mockery (respectively), and uḥ = displayed sorrow or pleasure and especially disgust.

conditions: avyaya ∈ {ಆಃ, ಅಃ, ಉಃ}
rule.operation: assign meaning: ಆಃ, ಅಃ = sudden astonishment / mockery / distress; ಉಃ = disgust, the unbearable (asahya)
also: variant reading (Kittel 1920): ಆಃ = astonishment, ಅಃ = mockery; ಉಃ also = manifest sorrow or joy

examples.note: meaning: interjection of disgust, the intolerable

mula:
ಸ್ಮರಣವಿಚಾರಾಮಂತ್ರಣ-
ಪರಿಗತವೆನಿಸಿರ್ಪುವೆಲೆಲೆ ಏ ಎಂಬಿವು ಸಂ-
ಚರಿಸುವುದನುಮತದೊಳ್ ಬ-
ಲ್ಲರಿನೇಕಾರಮದೆಕಾರಮವಧಾರಣೆಯೊಳ್
english: elele and ē are said to belong to recollection, deliberation and address; according to the learned, ē occurs in assent, and e in emphasis.
explanation_en: elele and ē are used in recalling something, in deliberating/wondering, and in calling someone (vocative address). In addition ē expresses assent ('yes, agreed'), and short e (attached to a word) expresses emphasis/restriction (avadhāraṇa, 'only, indeed'). The editorial vṛtti assigns both e and ē to emphasis; the verse assigns ē to assent and e to emphasis, matching Bhāṣābhūṣaṇa (ē = abhyupagama, e = avadhāraṇa).

conditions: avyaya ∈ {ಎಲೆಲೆ, ಏ, ಎ}
rule.operation: assign meaning: ಎಲೆಲೆ, ಏ = recollection, deliberation, address (vocative); ಏ also = assent; ಎ (clitic on a word) = emphasis/restriction (avadhāraṇa)

examples.note: meaning: interjection of recollection, deliberation or address ('O!, hey')

mula:
ಮತ್ತೆಂಬುದು ಪುನರರ್ಥದೊ-
ಳೆತ್ತಾನುಮದೆಲ್ಲಿಯಾನುಮೆಂಬರ್ಥದೊಳಾ-
ಯತ್ತಂಗಳರಮೆ ಅರೆಗಳ್
ಸುತ್ತೇಂ ತರಲಾರ್ಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳ್ಳಳಮಕ್ಕುಂ
english: matte is in the sense 'again'; arame and are are devoted to the sense 'ettānum', i.e. 'elliyānum'; in the sense 'tremulous' there is beḷḷaḷaṃ.
explanation_en: matte means 'again, further'. arame and are mean 'somewhere, in some place / at some time' (= ettānuṃ, elliyānuṃ; Bhāṣābhūṣaṇa: kvacit, kadācit). beḷḷaḷaṃ means 'tremblingly, unsteadily' (tarala/cañcala).

conditions: avyaya ∈ {ಮತ್ತೆ, ಅರಮೆ, ಅರೆ, ಬೆಳ್ಳಳಂ}
rule.operation: assign meaning: ಮತ್ತೆ = again (punar); ಅರಮೆ/ಅರೆ = somewhere, sometime (= ಎತ್ತಾನುಂ/ಎಲ್ಲಿಯಾನುಂ); ಬೆಳ್ಳಳಂ = tremulously (tarala)

ತರಲಾರ್ಥ (Venkat) vs ತರಳಾರ್ಥ (Kedilaya)

mula:
ಸಲೆಯೆಂಬುದು ನಿತ್ಯಾರ್ಥಾ-
ವಲಂಬಿ ಹುಂ ಎನೆಯುಂ ಅಲ್ತೆಯಲ್ತೆಯೆನೆಯುಂ
ಫಲಿಯಿಸುಗುಂ ಪ್ರಶ್ನಾರ್ಥೋ-
ಜ್ಜ್ವಲಾನುಮಾನಾರ್ಥಯುಗಳಮವು ಶಾಬ್ದಿಕರಿಂ
english: sale rests on the sense 'always'; when one says huṃ and when one says alte alte, the pair of senses — question and clear inference — results, according to grammarians.
explanation_en: sale means 'always, constantly, wholly'. huṃ and alte (cited reduplicated, alte alte) are used for questions and for inference/presumption ('isn't it?', 'surely'). (Bhāṣābhūṣaṇa per Kittel: alte in praśna and anumāna; huṃ also in vitarka, avadhāraṇa, nivāraṇa.)

conditions: avyaya ∈ {ಸಲೆ, ಹುಂ, ಅಲ್ತೆ}
rule.operation: assign meaning: ಸಲೆ = always (nitya); ಹುಂ, ಅಲ್ತೆ = question / inference

examples.note: meaning: particle of question or inference
meaning: 'is it not?' — question or inference (cited as ಅಲ್ತೆಯಲ್ತೆ)

mula:
ಅಮುಮೆಂಬಿವೆರಡುಮಮರ್ಗುಂ
ಸಮುಚ್ಚಯಾರ್ಥದೊಳೆ ಏ ಒ ಓ ಎಂಬಿವು ಶ-
ಬ್ದಮನಪ್ಪಿ ವಿಶಂಕಾಪ್ರ-
ಶ್ನಮಂಡಲಾಕ್ಷೇಪಕಾರ್ಥದೊಳ್ ವರ್ತಿಸುಗುಂ
english: The two, am and um, fit the sense of conjunction; e, ē, o, ō, embracing a word, occur in the senses of doubt, question and reproach.
explanation_en: -am and -um are conjunctive clitics ('and, also'; samuccaya), added to each conjoined word (e.g. rāmanum lakṣmaṇanum). The vowels -e, -ē, -o, -ō, attached at the end of a word, express doubt, question or reproach/censure (ākṣēpa).

conditions: right: clitic ಅಂ | ಉಂ attached to a word
or right: clitic ಎ | ಏ | ಒ | ಓ attached at word end
rule.operation: ಅಂ/ಉಂ = conjunction 'and, also' (samuccaya); ಎ/ಏ/ಒ/ಓ = doubt, question or reproach

pāda 1 seems one mātrā over for a kanda (ಅಮುಮೆಂಬಿವೆರಡುಮಮರ್ಗುಂ) in all editions

mula:
ಬೞಿಕೆ ಬೞಿಕ್ಕಂ ಬೞಿಕಂ
ಬೞಿಕ್ಕೆ ಬೞಿಯಂ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಪಶ್ಚಾದರ್ಥಂ
ಘಟಿಯಿಪುದು ವಿಕಲ್ಪಾರ್ಥಂ
ಕೞಲದೆ ಮೇಣೆಂಬ ಶಬ್ದದೊಳ್ ಶಾಬ್ದಿಕರಿಂ
english: baḻike, baḻikkaṃ, baḻikaṃ, baḻikke, baḻiyaṃ have the well-known sense 'afterwards'; the sense of alternative comes about, unfailingly, in the word mēṇ, according to grammarians.
explanation_en: Five variants meaning 'afterwards, then, after that' (paścāt): baḻike, baḻikkaṃ, baḻikaṃ, baḻikke, baḻiyaṃ. mēṇ means 'or' (alternative, vikalpa).

conditions: avyaya ∈ {ಬೞಿಕೆ, ಬೞಿಕ್ಕಂ, ಬೞಿಕಂ, ಬೞಿಕ್ಕೆ, ಬೞಿಯಂ} | ಮೇಣ್
rule.operation: assign meaning: ಬೞಿಕೆ-set = afterwards (paścāt); ಮೇಣ್ = or (vikalpa)

mula:
ಉಪಮಾನಾರ್ಥದೊಳಿವು ವ-
ರ್ತಿಪುವಂತಿರೆಯಂತೆಯಂತೆವೋಲ್ ವೋಲ್ಗಳ್ ರಂ-
ಜಿಪುವು ಗಡ ಗಳ ಗಡಂಗಳ-
ವುಪಚಿತವಾರ್ತೆಯೊಳಮುಚಿತಸಂಭಾಷಣೆಯೊಳ್
english: In the sense of comparison these occur: antire, ante, antevōl, vōl; gaḍa, gaḷa — these shine in courteous report and in fitting conversation.
explanation_en: Comparison particles 'like, as': antire, ante, antevōl, vōl (postposed to the standard of comparison). gaḍa and gaḷa are discourse particles used in polite/reported speech and in appropriate conversation ('it seems, they say, indeed'). (Bhāṣābhūṣaṇa: gaḍa, gaḷa in vārtā and sambhāṣaṇa.)

conditions: avyaya ∈ {ಅಂತಿರೆ, ಅಂತೆ, ಅಂತೆವೋಲ್, ವೋಲ್} | {ಗಡ, ಗಳ}
rule.operation: assign meaning: first set = 'like, as' (upamāna); ಗಡ/ಗಳ = reportative/courteous discourse particles

examples.note: meaning: reportative/courteous particle ('it is said, indeed')

mula:
ಮೆಱೆಗುಂ ಸುಮ್ಮನೆ ಸುಮ್ಮಗೆ
ಬಱಿದಲ್ಲವಱೆಂಬ ಮಾತಕಾರಣದೊಳ್ ಪೊ-
ಚ್ಚಱುಗುಂ ತೃತೀಯೆ ಬಂದಂ-
ತಱನೆಂಬ ಪದಕ್ಕಮಾ ಎಕಾರಕ್ಕಿತರಂ
english: The words summane, summage, baṟide, allavaṟ shine in the sense 'without cause'; to the word antaṟ the third case comes and attaches — other than the e-ending.
explanation_en: summane, summage, baṟide, allavaṟ mean 'without reason, for nothing, in vain'. The word antaṟ- ('that reason') takes the instrumental (3rd case) suffixes -iṃ, -indaṃ, -inde — but not the instrumental -e — giving antaṟiṃ, antaṟindaṃ, antaṟinde 'therefore, for that reason', which function as avyayas.

conditions: avyaya ∈ {ಸುಮ್ಮನೆ, ಸುಮ್ಮಗೆ, ಬಱಿದೆ, ಅಲ್ಲವಱ್}
rule.operation: assign meaning: 'without cause, in vain' (akāraṇa)
also: stem+suffix: left ಅಂತಱ್ + right instrumental suffix ∈ {ಇಂ, ಇಂದಂ, ಇಂದೆ} → ಅಂತಱಿಂ / ಅಂತಱಿಂದಂ / ಅಂತಱಿಂದೆ ('therefore'); instrumental -ಎ is NOT allowed

counterexamples.why: the instrumental -ಎ is excluded for ಅಂತಱ್ (ಎಕಾರಕ್ಕಿತರಂ); form constructed by the encoder

uncertain: pāda 2 ಬಳ್ದಲ್ಲವಳ್ಂಬ (OCR) read ಬಱಿದಲ್ಲವಱೆಂಬ; vṛtti OCR ಬಜ್ದೆ, ಅಲ್ಲವಾ read ಬಱಿದೆ, ಅಲ್ಲವಱ್ (Kedilaya ಅಲ್ಲವಱ್)
pāda 3 ಪೊಚ್ಚಜುಗುಂ read ಪೊಚ್ಚಱುಗುಂ (Kittel ಪೊಚ್ಚಱಿಗುಂ)
stem cited as ಅಂತಱನ್ (accusative of ಅಂತಱ್); exact citation form uncertain
ಸುಮನೆ ಸುಮಗೆ (OCR) read ಸುಮ್ಮನೆ ಸುಮ್ಮಗೆ (metre)

mula:
ಹೌವನೆಯಾಕಸ್ಮಿಕಭಯ-
ಭಾವಿತವಂತಿಂತುಗಳ್ ಪದಾಪೂರಣದೊಳ್
ಕೋವುವು ಚಿಃ ಇಸ್ಸೀಗಳ್
ತಾವೊಗೆದು ಜುಗುಪ್ಸನಾರ್ಥದೊಳ್ ವರ್ತಿಸುಗುಂ
english: hauvane is marked by suddenness and fear; antu and intu are strung in to fill out the verse; ciḥ and issī arise and occur in the sense of disgust.
explanation_en: hauvane expresses sudden alarm/surprise and fear. antu and intu are used as expletives to fill out a metrical line (pādapūraṇa), with no meaning of their own in that use. ciḥ and issī are interjections of disgust ('fie!').

conditions: avyaya ∈ {ಹೌವನೆ, ಅಂತು, ಇಂತು, ಚಿಃ, ಇಸ್ಸೀ}
rule.operation: assign meaning: ಹೌವನೆ = sudden fear/surprise; ಅಂತು/ಇಂತು = metrical expletive (pādapūraṇa, semantically empty); ಚಿಃ/ಇಸ್ಸೀ = disgust
also: ಅಂತು/ಇಂತು also have the 'manner' meaning (see 320)

mula:
ಮತ್ತೆಂಬರ್ಥದೊಳುಸಿರ್ವರ್
ಬಿತ್ತೆಗರಾ ಬಲ್ಲೆ ಬೞಿಗಳಂ ಕಾಲಾರ್ಥಂ
ಪತ್ತುವುದಂದಿಂದುಂದೆಂ-
ದೆತ್ತಂ ನುಡಿವವ್ಯಯಂಗಳೊಳ್ ವಾಗ್ವಿದರಿಂ
english: The learned use balle and baḻi in the sense 'matte' (then, further); the sense of time attaches, according to those who know speech, to the avyayas spoken as andu, indu, undu, endu.
explanation_en: balle and baḻi mean 'then, further, afterwards' (= matte). andu 'then (that day)', indu 'now, today', undu 'at this (intermediate) time', endu 'when' express time. They belong to the a-/i-/u-/e- deictic series (distal, proximal, intermediate, interrogative).
heading_en: balle/baḻi; time words andu, indu, undu, endu

conditions: avyaya ∈ {ಬಲ್ಲೆ, ಬೞಿ} | {ಅಂದು, ಇಂದು, ಉಂದು, ಎಂದು}
rule.operation: assign meaning: ಬಲ್ಲೆ/ಬೞಿ = then, further (= ಮತ್ತೆ); ಅಂದು/ಇಂದು/ಉಂದು/ಎಂದು = time (distal 'then' / proximal 'now' / intermediate / interrogative 'when')

uncertain: ಬಟಗಳೆಂ (verse OCR) / ಬಟು (vṛtti OCR) read ಬೞಿಗಳಂ / ಬೞಿ
gloss of ಉಂದು (intermediate deixis) is the encoder's

mula:
ಭ್ರಾಂತಿಯನುೞಿದಂತಿಂತುಂ-
ತೆಂತೆಂಬಿವು ತಾಂ ಪ್ರಕಾರಕಾಲ್ಯಾರ್ಥಂಗಳ್
ಮುಂತೆ ಚತುರ್ಥೀಷಷ್ಠೀ-
ಕಾಂತಂಗಳವೆಂದು ತಿಳಿಗೆ ಪೇೞ್ವವ್ಯಯಮಂ
english: Leaving aside confusion: antu, intu, untu, entu have the sense of manner; let it be known that the avyayas to be stated next are graced with the fourth and sixth case endings.
explanation_en: antu 'in that way, thus', intu 'in this way', untu 'in this (intermediate) way', entu 'how?' are avyayas of manner. Adhikāra for 321–322: the time-avyayas stated next, unlike avyayas in general, take dative (4th case) and genitive (6th case) endings.
heading_en: Manner words antu/intu/untu/entu; case-taking time words

conditions: avyaya ∈ {ಅಂತು, ಇಂತು, ಉಂತು, ಎಂತು}
rule.operation: assign meaning: manner (distal 'thus' / proximal 'so' / intermediate / interrogative 'how')
also: adhikāra: the time-avyayas of 321–322 accept dative and genitive suffixes (exception to avyaya indeclinability)

mula:
ತಳೆಗುಂ ಕಾಲಾರ್ಥಮನಾ-
ಗಳೀಗಳೆಂಬಾಗಡೀಗಡೆಂಬಿವು ಬಿಂದೂ-
ಜ್ಜ್ವಳಮುಮಿವುದಯಮನುಸಿರ್ವುವು
ತಿಳಿ ಸವಳದೆ ಪೊೞ್ತಡೆನೆ ಸವಳ್ತಡೆಯೆನೆಯುಂ
vrtti: ಇವಱೊಳ್ ಚತುರ್ಥೀಷಷ್ಠಿಗಳ್ ಪತ್ತುವಂದಮಂ ಉದಾಹರಿಪೆಂ — ಆಗಳಿಂಗೆ, ಈಗಳಿಂಗೆ, ಆಗಡಿಂಗೆ, ಈಗಡಿಂಗೆ; ಆಗಳಿನ, ಈಗಳಿನ, ಆಗಡಿನ, ಈಗಡಿನ; [ಆಗಳುಂ, ಈಗಳುಂ; ಆಗಡುಂ, ಈಗಡುಂ]; ಸವಳ್ತಡಿಂಗೆ, ಪೊೞ್ತಡಿಂಗೆ; ಸವಳ್ತಡಿನ, ಪೊೞ್ತಡಿನ. ಸವಳದೆಗೆ ಆಗದು.
english: āgaḷ, īgaḷ, āgaḍu, īgaḍu bear the sense of time and are bright with the bindu; know that savaḷade, poḻtaḍe and savaḷtaḍe express daybreak.
explanation_en: Time avyayas that take case endings (cf. 320): āgaḷ 'then', īgaḷ 'now', āgaḍu 'then', īgaḍu 'now'; and savaḷade, poḻtaḍe, savaḷtaḍe 'at daybreak, in the morning'. They form a dative in -iṅge (with anusvāra, the 'bindu' of the verse) and a genitive in -ina: āgaḷiṅge, āgaḷina; poḻtaḍiṅge, poḻtaḍina. savaḷade takes neither. The bracketed forms āgaḷuṃ, īgaḷuṃ, āgaḍuṃ, īgaḍuṃ (with -um 'also/ever') are an editorial addition in the 2015 edition.

ಸವಸಂದ ಕಾಲವಾಚಕ-
ಮಿವು ನಾಡಿದು ನಾಳೆ ನಿನ್ನೆ ಮೊನ್ನೆಗಳಾದಂ
ವಿವರಿಪುವೀವಱು ಮೊನೆಯೇ-
ಡವು ಕಿಂಚಿದ್ಭೂತಭೂತಕಾಲದ್ವಯದೊಳ್
vrtti: ಇವಱೊಳ್ ಚತುರ್ಥೀಷಷ್ಠಿಗಳ್ ಪತ್ತುವಂದಮಂ ಉದಾಹರಿಪೆಂ — … ನಾಳಿಂಗೆ, ನಾಡಿದಿಂಗೆ, ನಿನ್ನಿಂಗೆ, ಮೊನ್ನಿಂಗೆ; ನಾಳಿನ, ನಾಡಿದಿನ, ನಿನ್ನಿನ, ಮೊನ್ನಿನ; ಈವಱಿಂಗೆ, ಮೊನೆಯೇಡಿಂಗೆ; ಈವಱಿನ, ಮೊನೆಯೇಡಿನ. (ಈವಱೆಂಬುದು ಈಷದ್ಭೂತಕಾಲಂ; ಮೊನೆಯೇಡೆಂಬುದು ಭೂತಕಾಲಂ; ಇವು ವರ್ಷವಾಚಕಂಗಳಾಗಿ ಕಾಲೋಪಯುಕ್ತಂಗಳ್.)
english: These — nāḍidu, nāḷe, ninne, monne — are well-established time-words; īvaṟu and moneyēḍu explain the pair of times, the slightly past and the past.
explanation_en: Further case-taking time avyayas: nāḍidu 'the day after tomorrow', nāḷe 'tomorrow', ninne 'yesterday', monne 'the day before yesterday'; īvaṟu 'the recent past' and moneyēḍu 'the (more remote) past' — the vṛtti says these two denote years (īvaṟu ≈ last year, moneyēḍu ≈ the year before). All take dative -iṅge and genitive -ina after dropping the final vowel: nāḷiṅge, nāḷina; īvaṟiṅge, moneyēḍina.
heading_en: Day/year words taking dative and genitive

english: As the Sanskrit (list of) roots came from Bhīma, equal to the Veda, in that same way the Kannada (list of) roots came from the poet Keśava, preceptor of the Yādava court.
explanation_en: Opening verse of the Dhātu-prakaraṇa. Kēśirāja (calling himself Kavi-Keśava, teacher at the Yādava court) presents his Kannada dhātupāṭha as the counterpart of the Sanskrit dhātupāṭha ascribed to Bhīma(sena). It introduces the root list that follows and contains no operational rule.
heading_en: Introduction to the Kannada root list

vrtti: ವರ್ಗದ್ವಿತೀಯಚತುರ್ಥಾಕ್ಷರಂಗಳುಂ ಙ ಞ ಶ ಷ ಹ ಕ್ಷ ಕಾರಂಗಳುಮಂತಂಗಳಾಗಿರ್ಪ ಧಾತುಗಳ್ ಕನ್ನಡದೊಳ್ ನಿಸರ್ಗದಿನಿಲ್ಲೆಂಬುದು ಶಾಬ್ದಿಕಮತಮೆಂದಱಿವುದು.
english: According to the learned, roots do not arise (in Kannada) ending in the aspirate letters together with their peers, nor ending in ṅa, ña, śa, ṣa, ha or kṣa; know the roots in this order.
explanation_en: Phonotactic constraint on Kannada verb roots: by nature no native (dēśya) root ends in an aspirated stop (the 2nd and 4th letters of each varga: kh, gh, ch, jh, ṭh, ḍh, th, dh, ph, bh) or in ṅ, ñ, ś, ṣ, h, kṣ. The verse also announces the arrangement of the following list, which groups roots by their final sound (vowel-final roots first, then k-, g-, c-, j-, ṭ-, ḍ-, ṇ-, t-, d-final, etc.). Roots with such finals are therefore not Kannada roots; Sanskrit loan roots are outside the scope.
heading_en: No Kannada roots end in aspirates, ṅ ñ ś ṣ h kṣ

conditions: applies to native Kannada verbal roots (dhātu)
rule.operation: constraint: a root-final segment may not be an aspirated stop (varga 2nd/4th letters) or ಙ, ಞ, ಶ, ಷ, ಹ, ಕ್ಷ
also: arrangement: the dhātupāṭha that follows is ordered by root-final sound (ಸ್ವರ, ಕ, ಗ, ಚ, ಜ, ಟ, ಡ, ಣ, ತ, ದ, …)

ಕಿರಾತಮಿವು ಕೇಶಿರಾಜಕವಿರಚಿತಂಗಳ್
english: The renowned Cōḷapālakacarita, Śrī-Citramāle, likewise Subhadrāharaṇa, Prabōdhacandra and Kirāta — these are composed by the poet Kēśirāja.
explanation_en: Lists Kēśirāja's other (lost) works: Cōḷapālakacarita, Śrīcitramāle, Subhadrāharaṇa, Prabōdhacandra, Kirāta.

ಕರಮಾದುದೆಂದು ಬುಧರಾ-
ದರಿಪರ್ ಮೆಚ್ಚೆಂದೆ ಶಬ್ದಮಣಿದರ್ಪಣಮಂ

explanation_en: Praise of the book: it is a mirror (darpaṇa) for Lakṣmī and a second lute for Sarasvatī; the learned esteem it.

label: samapti_4
mula:
ಆರ್ಯನ ಯಾದವಕಟಕಾ-
ಚಾರ್ಯನ ಕೇಶವನ ಶಬ್ದಮಣಿದರ್ಪಣಮುಂ
ಸೂರ್ಯೇಂದುಮೇರುವಾರಿಧಿ-
ಪರ್ಯಂತಂ ಪರೆದು ನಿಲ್ಕನಾಕುಳದಿಂದಂ
english: May the Śabdamaṇidarpaṇa of the noble Kēśava, teacher of the Yādava court, spread and endure undisturbed as long as the sun, the moon, Mount Mēru and the ocean.
explanation_en: Benediction for the permanence of the work; names the author as Kēśava, ācārya at the Yādava (Hoysaḷa-period Yādava?) court.

label: samapti_5
mula:
ಗಮಕಸಮಾಸದಿಂ ಱೞಕುಳಕ್ಷಳದಿಂ ಶ್ರುತಿಸಹ್ಯಸಂಧಿಯಿಂ
ಸಮುಚಿತಮಾಗಿ ಬರ್ಪ ಸತಿಸಪ್ತಮಿಯಿಂ ಸಮಸಂಸ್ಕೃತೋಕ್ತಿಯಿಂ
ವಮಹಪಭೇದದಿಂ ವಿರಹಿತಾವ್ಯಯಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಲಿಂಗದಿಂ ಪದೋ-
ತ್ತಮಶಿಥಿಲತ್ವದಿಂ ಯತಿವಿಲಂಘನದಿಂದರಿದಲ್ತೆ ಕನ್ನಡಂ
english: Because of gamaka-compounds, because of ṟa, ḻa, kuḷa and kṣaḷa, because of sandhi agreeable to the ear, because of the locative absolute used fittingly, because of speech mixed evenly with Sanskrit, because of the distinction of va/ma/ha/pa, because of Sanskrit stems without avyayas, because of the looseness of excellent words, because of transgression of the caesura — is not Kannada difficult?
explanation_en: Campakamāle verse summarising the hard points of Kannada that the grammar has dealt with: gamakasamāsa, the letters ಱ/ೞ and the two kinds of ಳ (kuḷa = Kannada ḷa, kṣaḷa = Sanskrit-derived ḷa), euphonic sandhi, sati-saptamī, mixing Sanskrit, the v/m/h/p alternations, Sanskrit nominal stems, word looseness and yati. Several items are obscure.
heading_en: Closing verse 5: why Kannada is difficult

mula:
ಅಪರಿಮಿತವಿದ್ಯರೆನಿಸಿ-
ರ್ದ ಪುರಾಣಕವೀಂದ್ರರಖಿಳಕಾವ್ಯಂಗಳ ಗೂ-
ಢಪದಪ್ರಯೋಗಮಂ ನೆರ-
ಪಿ ಪದಾರ್ಥಂಗಳನಣಂ ಮನಂಬುಗೆ ಪೇೞ್ಕೆಂ
vrtti: ಇವೆಲ್ಲಂ ಕವಿಮಾರ್ಗಮನೋಹರಂಗಳ್ ನಿರ್ದುಷ್ಟಂಗಳ್; ಇನ್ನುಮಿವು ಮೊದಲಾದುವಂ ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ವುದು.
english: Having gathered the obscure word-usages (gūḍhapada-prayōga) in all the poems of the ancient master-poets, who were renowned for boundless learning, I shall state the meanings of the words so that they enter the mind clearly.
explanation_en: Opening kanda verse of the Prayōgasāra ('Essence of usage'), also called Śabdārtha-nirṇaya, an appendix to the Śabdamaṇidarpaṇa that glosses rare Old Kannada words used by earlier poets (e.g. ಕನ್ನಡವಕ್ಕಿ = ಗಿಳಿ 'parrot'). The glossary itself follows as plain 'X = Y' entries and is encoded separately in data/lexicon/parts/prayogasara.json. The closing remark (given here as vrtti) says that all these words are charming in poetic usage and faultless, and that readers should look out for further such words themselves. The 2015 edition prints the Prayōgasāra as Pariśiṣṭa 2, noting that the palm-leaf manuscripts do not number it as a ninth chapter.

rule.operation: introduces a glossary of rare poetic words (headword = meaning); no grammatical operation

mula:
ಶ್ರೀ ವಾಗ್ದೇವಿಗೆ ಶಬ್ದದಿ-
ನಾವಾವಿಂದ್ರಿಯದ ವಿಷಯಮಂ ಶ್ರೋತ್ರದೊಳು-
ದ್ಭಾವಿಪ ನಿರ್ಮಲಮೂರ್ತಿಗಿ-
ಳಾವಂದ್ಯೆಗೆ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಮುಖದೊಳವನತನಪ್ಪೆಂ
vrtti: ಕಾಂತಿಯೆಂಬ ಗುಣದೊಳನ್ವಿತೆಯಪ್ಪ ವಾಕ್ಕೆಂಬ ದೇವಿಗೆ ಪಂಚೇಂದ್ರಿಯಂಗಳ ವಿಷಯಮಪ್ಪ ಶಬ್ದ ಸ್ಪರ್ಶ ರೂಪ ರಸ ಗಂಧಂಗಳೊಳಂ ಶ್ರೋತ್ರೇಂದ್ರಿಯಮೊಂದಱಲ್ಲಿಯೆ ಶಬ್ದಮುಖದಿನಭಿವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯಂ ಮಾೞ್ಪ ವಿಮಲಸ್ವರೂಪೆಗೆ ಭುವನಸ್ತುತ್ಯೆಗೆ ಈ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಪ್ರಾರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ನಮಸ್ಕರಿಸುವಾತನಪ್ಪೆಂ.
english: At the opening of the treatise I bow to the glorious goddess of Speech, of spotless form, adored by the world, who through sound manifests in the ear alone the objects of every sense.
explanation_en: Maṅgala (invocation) to Vāgdēvī (Sarasvatī). The vṛtti explains that of the five sense-objects (sound, touch, form, taste, smell) all are made known through words heard by the ear alone, so Speech is the revealer of everything.
heading_en: Invocation to the goddess of Speech

mula:
ಕವಿ ಸುಮನೋಬಾಣನ ಯಾ-
ದವಕಟಕಾಚಾರ್ಯನೆಸೆವ ದೌಹಿತ್ರನೆನಾಂ
ಕವಿ ಕೇಶವನೆಂ ಯೋಗಿ-
ಪ್ರವರ ಚಿದಾನಂದ ಮಲ್ಲಿಕಾರ್ಜುನ ಸುತನೆಂ
vrtti: ಯಾದವಕಟಕೋಪಾಧ್ಯಾಯನಪ್ಪ ಕವಿ ಸುಮನೋಬಾಣನ ಮಗಳ ಮಗನೆಂ, ಯೋಗಿವಲ್ಲಭನಪ್ಪ ಮಲ್ಲಿಕಾರ್ಜುನನಂದನನೆಂ, ಕೇಶಿರಾಜ ಕವಿಯೆಂ ಆಂ.
english: I am the illustrious daughter's son of the poet Sumanōbāṇa, preceptor of the Yādava court; I am the poet Kēśava, son of Cidānanda Mallikārjuna, foremost of yogis.
explanation_en: Author's self-introduction: Kēśirāja (Kēśava), son of Mallikārjuna and maternal grandson of the poet Sumanōbāṇa, teacher at the Yādava (Sēuṇa) court.

mula:
ಗುಣಮಮರೆ ಶಬ್ದಮಣಿದ-
ರ್ಪಣ ನಾಮವನಿಟ್ಟು ನೆಱೆಯೆ ಕರ್ಣಾಟಕಲ-
ಕ್ಷಣ ಶಬ್ದಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಮಂ ಲಾ-
ಕ್ಷಣಿಕರ್ಪೇೞ್ಕೆಂದು ಬೆಸಸೆ ಬಗೆವುಗೆ ಪೇೞ್ಕೆಂ
vrtti: ಶಬ್ದಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯಮಮರೆ, ವಿಸ್ತರದಿಂ ಕರ್ಣಾಟಕವ್ಯಾಕರಣಮಂ, ಶಬ್ದಮಣಿದರ್ಪಣಮೆಂಬ ಪೆಸರನಿಟ್ಟು, ಲಕ್ಷಣಾಚಾರ್ಯರ್ ಪೇೞ್ಕೆಂದು ಬೆಸಸೆ, ಮನಂಬುಗುವಂತೆ ಪೇೞ್ಕೆಂ.
english: As the grammarians bade me 'tell it', I shall tell, fully and so that it enters the mind, a science of words describing Kannada, giving it the name Śabdamaṇidarpaṇa ('Mirror of the jewel of words') so that its merit be fitting.
explanation_en: States the title and purpose: a full grammar (lakṣaṇa) of Kannada, composed at the request of grammarians.
heading_en: Title and purpose of the work

mula:
ಅವಧರಿಪುದು ವಿಬುಧರ್ ದೋ-
ಷವಿದಱೊಳೇನಾನುಮುಳ್ಳೊಡಂ ಪ್ರಿಯದಿಂ ತಿ-
ರ್ದುವುದು ಗುಣಯುಕ್ತಮುಂ ದೋ-
ಷವಿದೂರಮುಮಾಗೆ ಮೆಚ್ಚಿ ಕೈಕೊಳ್ವುದಿದಂ
vrtti: ಶಬ್ದಮಣಿದರ್ಪಣದೊಳೇನಾನುಂ ದೋಷಮುಳ್ಳೊಡಂ ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸರವಧರಿಸಿ ಕೇಳ್ದು, ಕರುಣದಿಂ ಮನಃಪ್ರೀತಿವೆರಸಿ ತಿರ್ದುವುದು; ಗುಣಾನ್ವಿತಮುಂ ನಿರ್ದೋಷಮುಮಾಗೆ, ಮೆಚ್ಚಿ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಪುದು.
english: Let the learned attend; if there is any fault in this, let them correct it with kindness, and when it is full of merit and far from fault, let them accept it with approval.
explanation_en: Customary request to scholars to hear the work, correct its faults and accept it.

mula:
ಗಜಗನ ಗುಣನಂದಿಯ ಮನ-
ಸಿಜನಸಗನ ಚಂದ್ರಭಟ್ಟ ಗುಣವರ್ಮ ಶ್ರೀ-
ವಿಜಯರ ಹೊನ್ನನ ಹಂಪನ
ಸುಜನೋತ್ತಂಸನ ಸುಮಾರ್ಗಮಿದಱೊಳೆ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಯಂ

explanation_en: Names the authoritative poets whose works supply the examples (lakṣya); the vṛtti adds that many other famous poets are also quoted.

mula:
ಪ್ರಾಸಚ್ಛಂದೋನ್ವಯವಿ-
ನ್ಯಾಸದಿನಂತಿಂತು ಶಬ್ದಮಿರ್ಕುಂ ವೃತ್ತಿ-
ವ್ಯಾಸಂ ತದ್ವ್ಯಾಕುಳಮೆಂ-
ದಾ ಸೂತ್ರಕ್ಕರ್ಥವೃತ್ತಿ ವರ್ತಿಸೆ ಬರೆದೆಂ
vrtti: ಪ್ರಾಸದ, ಛಂದದ, ಅನ್ವಯದ ನಿಱುಗೆಯಿಂ ಶಬ್ದಂಗಳ್ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಯಮಾಗಿರ್ಪುವು; ಅವಱವಱ ಬೞಿಯೊಳ್ ವೃತ್ತಿಯ ವಿಸ್ತರಂ ವ್ಯಾಕುಲಮಾದಪುದೆಂದಾ ಸೂತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ತಾತ್ಪರ್ಯಾರ್ಥಂ ಪ್ರವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತುಮಿರೆ ವೃತ್ತಿಯಂ ಬರೆದೆಂ.
english: Because of the requirements of prāsa (second-syllable rhyme), metre and syntax, words stand here and there out of order; thinking that an expanded commentary would be confusing, I wrote a vṛtti giving the meaning for each sūtra.
explanation_en: Method: the sūtras are kanda verses whose word order is disturbed by prāsa, metre and syntax, so Kēśirāja adds his own prose vṛtti to each sūtra stating its sense.
heading_en: Why the author wrote a vṛtti

ಜನಮಂಗೀಕರಿಪುದು ನೆ-
ಟ್ಟನೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಾಭಿಧೇಯ ಶಕ್ಯಾನುಷ್ಠಾ-
ನ ನಿಜೇಷ್ಟಸಿದ್ಧಿಗಳ್ ನೆಲೆ-
ಸಿ ನಿಂದ ಕಾರಣದೆ ಶಬ್ದಮಣಿದರ್ಪಣಮಂ
vrtti: ಸಂಬಂಧಮೆಂದು ಪೊರ್ದುಗೆ; ಅಭಿಧೇಯಮೆಂದರ್ಥಂ; ಶಕ್ಯಾನುಷ್ಠಾನಮೆಂದಾ ಪದಾರ್ಥಮಂ ಸಾಧಿಸಲಕ್ಕುದ್ಯೋಗಂ; ಇಷ್ಟಸಿದ್ಧಿಯೆಂದದಱ ಫಲಪ್ರಾಪ್ತಿ — ಇವು ಶಬ್ದಮಣಿದರ್ಪಣದೊಳ್ ನೆಲೆಗೊಂಡಿರ್ಪುದಱಿಂ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸದ ಲೋಕಮಿಲ್ಲ.
english: People will surely accept the Śabdamaṇidarpaṇa, because relation (sambandha), subject-matter (abhidhēya), practicable undertaking (śakyānuṣṭhāna) and attainment of the desired goal (iṣṭasiddhi) stand firmly established in it.
explanation_en: The traditional anubandha-catuṣṭaya: the work has a defined relation, subject matter, feasible method and fruit, hence everyone will accept it.
heading_en: The four prerequisites of a śāstra

mula:
ಕ್ರಮದಿಂದೆ ಸಂಧಿ ನಾಮಂ
ಸಮಾಸಮಾ ತದ್ಧಿತಂ ಪೊದೞ್ದಾಖ್ಯಾತಂ
ಪ್ರಮುದಿತ ಧಾತುವಪಭ್ರಂ-
ಶಮವ್ಯಯಂ ಸಂಧಿ ಶಬ್ದಮಣಿದರ್ಪಣದೊಳ್
vrtti: ತಱುವಾಯಿಂ ಸಂಧಿಯೆಂದುಂ, ನಾಮಮೆಂದುಂ, ಸಮಾಸಮೆಂದುಂ, ತದ್ಧಿತಮೆಂದುಂ, ಆಖ್ಯಾತಮೆಂದುಂ, ಧಾತುವೆಂದುಂ, ಅಪಭ್ರಂಶಮೆಂದುಂ, ಅವ್ಯಯಮೆಂದುಂ, ಈ ಶಬ್ದಮಣಿದರ್ಪಣದೊಳ್ ಸಂಧಿಯೆಂಟಕ್ಕುಂ.
english: In the Śabdamaṇidarpaṇa the divisions (sandhi) are, in order: Sandhi, Nāma, Samāsa, the well-known Taddhita, Ākhyāta, the delightful Dhātu, Apabhraṃśa and Avyaya.
explanation_en: Table of contents. The grammar (after the introductory saṃjñā section) has eight chapters, which Kēśirāja himself calls 'sandhi's (joints/sections): 1 sandhi (euphony), 2 nāma (nominal declension), 3 samāsa (compounds), 4 taddhita (secondary derivation), 5 ākhyāta (verbs), 6 dhātu (root list), 7 apabhraṃśa (tadbhava formation), 8 avyaya (indeclinables).
heading_en: The eight chapters of the grammar

rule.operation: declares the chapter structure

ಅನುಕೂಲಪವನನಿಂ ಜೀ-
ವನಿಷ್ಟದಿಂ ನಾಭಿಮೂಲದೊಳ್ ಕಹಳೆಯ ಪಾಂ-
ಗಿನವೋಲ್ ಶಬ್ದದ್ರವ್ಯಂ
ಜನಿಯಿಸುಗುಂ ಶ್ವೇತಮದಱ ಕಾರ್ಯಂ ಶಬ್ದಂ
vrtti: ಅನುಕೂಲಪವನನ ಬೆಂಬೞಿಯಿಂ ಜೀವನೊಡನೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಮಾಗಿರ್ಪುದಱಿಂ ನಾಭಿಯ ಮೊದಲಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಗಪಿದ ಕಹಳೆಯಾಕಾರದಿಂ ಶಬ್ದಮೆಂಬ ದ್ರವ್ಯಂ ಧವಳವರ್ಣಮಾಗಿ ಪುಟ್ಟುಗುಂ; ಅದಱ ಕಾರ್ಯಮಂ ಶಬ್ದಮೆಂಬರ್.
english: By the will of the soul, through a favourable breath, the substance of sound (śabdadravya) is born white at the root of the navel, in the shape of a trumpet; its effect is (audible) sound.
explanation_en: Phonetic/metaphysical preamble (Jaina view that sound is a substance, dravya): sound-substance arises at the navel driven by breath and the soul's intention; what we hear is its product.

rule.operation: none (non-operational verse)

mula:
ವ್ಯಾಕರಣದಿಂದೆ ಪದಮಾ
ವ್ಯಾಕರಣದ ಪದದಿನರ್ಥಮರ್ಥದೆ ತತ್ತ್ವಾ-
ಲೋಕಂ ತತ್ತ್ವಾಲೋಕದಿ-
ನಾಕಾಂಕ್ಷಿಪ ಮುಕ್ತಿಯಕ್ಕುಮದೆ ಬುಧರ್ಗೆ ಫಲಂ
vrtti: ವ್ಯಾಕರಣದಿಂದೆ ಪದಸಿದ್ಧಿಯಕ್ಕುಂ; ಆ ವ್ಯಾಕರಣದ ಪದಸಿದ್ಧಿಯಿಂದರ್ಥಜ್ಞಾನಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ಆ ಜ್ಞಾನದಿಂ ತತ್ತ್ವವಿಚಾರಮಕ್ಕುಂ; ತತ್ತ್ವವಿಚಾರದಿಂ ಬಯಸುವ ಮುಕ್ತಿ ದೊರೆಕೊಳ್ಳುಂ; ಬುಧರ್ಗದುಕಾರಣದಿಂ ವ್ಯಾಕರಣಮುಪಾದೇಯಂ.
english: From grammar comes the (correct) word; from the word of grammar, meaning; from meaning, insight into truth; from insight into truth, the longed-for liberation — that is the fruit for the wise.
explanation_en: Purpose (prayojana) of grammar: correct words → meaning → knowledge of reality → liberation; hence grammar is to be studied.

rule.operation: none (non-operational verse)
